articleTitle: Theoretical Approach to Calculating Reverse Intermodulation Distortion in Voltage Mode Class D RF Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The development of 5G technologies, Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) systems and Internet of Things (IoT) leads to change in the traditional paradigm of frequency-territorial planning. Indeed, in addition to reducing the distance between base stations of cellular communication, there is a problem of come close to them by radio means of mobile devices. In these cases, reverse intermodulation distortion (RIMD) occurs between closely spaced simultaneously operating transmitters. If they fall into the reception band, they disrupt the normal functioning of radio equipment. Therefore, the requirements for transmitters EMC characteristics are increasing. Class D power amplifiers in addition to higher efficiency, potentially, may have lower RIMD. The article discusses RIMD in previously unexplored Voltage Mode Class D (VMCD) RF Power Amplifiers. The theoretical approach to calculating RIMD in VMCD RF power amplifiers has been developed. The analysis performed showed that in order to achieve the desired levels of intermodulation distortion, not exceeding -70 dB, it is necessary to ensure the difference in saturation resistances is not more than 20% and saturation time deviation from the meander is not more than 2 degrees.

articleTitle: Application of the Backman Model for the Distribution of Traffic Flows in Networks with Segment Routing
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: When managing the flow of traffic in a large-scale network, it is necessary to take into account the speed of its generation by network users in order to determine and implement its optimal distribution between network routes in order to meet the quality of service parameters. In networks with a complex structure, it is more likely to expect a large load on its individual nodes, which subsequently leads to the formation of queues and traffic delays. One of the ways to overcome this situation is the transition from IP/MPLS protocols to segment routing technology, which should increase the flexibility of work and reduce the total number of protocols in the network. Segment routing also allows you to choose the optimal channels, with its help it is possible to provide both rapid re-routing and additional optimization of traffic routes in complex networks. Flow load balancing distributes packets across multiple channels and allows the router to use multiple paths to achieve even load distribution. In this case, it is possible to apply the Backman model for an equilibrium distribution of flows in a network with segment routing.

articleTitle: Determination of Semantic Proximity of Natural Language Terms for Subsequent Neural Network Training
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Systems that are controlled using natural language must strictly follow the commands given to them. In any voice command, there is both useful information corresponding to this command and extraneous noise. The actuator must separate the command from the noise. If we take a primitive approach to the process of human survival in the world around us, then it depends on the correct response to events, i.e. reaction to external irritation. This reaction is known as a reflex and is presented in two types, unconditional: breathing, swallowing, sucking, pulling the hand away from the cold and conditional: reading, various skills and abilities. Unconditional ones are embedded in our body from birth, and conditional ones we acquire through learning in the course of life, but despite their differences, they are united by one thing - responding to an event. The paper proposes a solution to this problem by determining the semantic proximity of a command issued in a natural language with a digital representation of its ideal. At the first stage, a natural language simulator is its textual representation.

articleTitle: Mathematical Method for Optimising the Transport and Logistics Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The aim of the work is to create a concept for the development of intelligent transport systems (ITS) to improve the efficiency of transport services. The scientific and practical value of the results lies in the use of multi-criteria analysis of the impact of ITS services on improving the efficiency of transport services and in the development of practical recommendations for the use of ITS services in transport systems. In this paper a method for process optimization has been developed, taking into account dynamically changing states of the system and several performance criteria. The principles of dynamic intelligent system with its inherent properties are developed. The scheme of management in transport and logistics system is composed. The principle of decision making in the dynamic system of the third type is formed. Three basic types of dynamic expert systems are considered. Comparisons with conventional combinatorial methods have been made, where clear advantages of the dynamic method have been identified

articleTitle: Software-Defined Radio Network Positioning Technology Design. Problem Statement
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: User equipment (UE) location estimation using existing cellular and other wireless communications systems infrastructure is an up-to-date and in demand field of research and investigation for GNSS-denied environments. Most popular standard network positioning technologies are based on 3GPP LTE and 5G NR positioning reference signals (PRS) as primary measurement and hyperbolic location estimation with Time Difference Of Arrival (TDOA) as secondary processing technique. Current investigation is devoted to foreign state of the art overview in the field of LTE and NR localization system implementation based on Software-defined radio (SDR). The result of analysis is problem statement for own network positioning technology design with Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) hardware and Mathworks software.

articleTitle: Research of the Convolutional and Product Turbo Codes Characteristics in Conditions of Underwater Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Acoustic underwater communication is a promising direction in the development of communication systems with underwater objects, requiring the development of the applied signal code structures. This research aims to find the optimal turbo coding solution for improving noise immunity in underwater communications with orthogonal chirp modulation. This problem is relevant in several areas: for underwater monitoring, highly reliable communications with far remote subscribers as well as for the Internet of things – for normal functioning of ultra-low power water purity sensors.

articleTitle: Using Intelligent Testing as a Tool to Improve the Quality of Transport Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: When launching an information system on the market, the manufacturer must make sure of its quality, for which comprehensive testing is carried out. The deeper the testing is carried out, the better the product should be. Unfortunately, in rare cases it is possible to achieve exhaustive testing, since in complex systems there are a large number of branches that need to be checked, which takes a lot of time. For a more optimal use of the time resource, various testing techniques are used. The paper suggests the possibility of testing transport information systems using intellectual means and the final gain in time resources is analyzed.

articleTitle: Data Fabric as an Effective Method of Data Management in Traffic and Road Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the basic principles of Data Fabric technology using the example of IBM, Microsoft and Cloudera platforms, which opened a new perspective in the field of data management, where it became possible to implement big data in the cloud, which supports the processes of organizing and preparing for use and analysis of huge amounts of information. The presented concept of Data Fabric technology can look like a system for collecting data on transport events and can be created on the principle of a blockchain network using a transport environment modeling tool. The data structures will contain data collected about accidents involving vehicles, reports of vehicle owners, roadside equipment of the transport and road complex systems. Blockchain can be used to create a secure, trusted, and decentralized autonomous Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) ecosystem that makes better use of the legacy ITS infrastructure and resources, which is especially effective for crowdsourcing technology. While it’s not enough to just collect and store large amounts of data, businesses need to seamlessly and securely access, manage and use this data to drive digital transformation and successfully implement artificial intelligence. The article is aimed at stimulating further developments and providing useful materials for future research in this area.

articleTitle: On the Effect of a Signal Delay on Cross-Spectral Correlation Function
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents a thorough analysis of the effects which a signal delay caused to cross-spectral cyclostationary characteristics for the case of relatively simple harmonizable signals. The signal of interest and its delayed version are observed by the antenna system being modeled as two receivers whose coordinates are assumed known and remained constant. The signal measurement is carried out in a presence of an interference that overlaps the signal in both time and frequency domain but not in the cyclic frequency domain, where the signal possesses unique cyclic frequency pattern. Cross-spectral characteristics for stationary and cyclostationary cases are presented and analyzed in the form of analytical expression, followed by the simulation results using Mote Carlo method. Paper highlights different statistical properties of the estimates evaluated for these two cases and with possible applications such as time difference of arrival problem considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of Resilience Indicators in Corporate Networks and Possible Ways to Improve It
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Data transmission networks are currently one of the important elements for ensuring uninterrupted and reliable daily operations of enterprises, in particular, and the global economy as a whole. Corporate networks can be characterized as one of the most important infrastructures on which the vital activity of society depends, along with transport infrastructure, electric power, etc. In addition, many of these infrastructures depend on each other. A modern corporate network is an information and communications system that unites all functional divisions of an enterprise into a single information space, regardless of their location, to ensure the effective functioning of information infrastructure and business processes. A properly designed and configured network ensures reliable and continuous operation of business processes, as well as user interaction, regardless of where they are located. At the same time, when designing and operating networks, attention is not always paid to such important indicators as sustainability, reliability and survivability, which can lead to extremely negative consequences for both the functioning of the corporate network and the enterprise itself. In this publication, an attempt is made to form a strategy to increase the resilience of corporate networks.

articleTitle: Analysis of Interference HF Range
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the interference environment in the decameter range. High-frequency communication remains indispensable in emergency situations. At the same time, the range is heavily loaded with various broadcasting stations. Software has been developed that allows collecting data on the interference environment around the clock. Then, based on these data, carry out a statistical analysis of the time-frequency sections for the presence of interference. The paper presents the results of the analysis of the high-frequency range obtained for the year. The possibility of using these data during communication sessions is shown.

articleTitle: Investigation of Portable Communication Devices with Electrochemical Power Sources Application Features
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this article we discuss the use of portable subscriber communication devices in which the power is supplied by primary cells and batteries. The article highlights the safety issues of the handheld portable subscriber communication devices which are related to electrochemical power sources using in such devices. The issues of safe electrochemical power sources using in terms of heating temperature during normal operation and in case of malfunctions are considered. The results of the conducted experimental research of manganese-zinc primary cells with salt and alkaline electrolytes and batteries to determine the maximum surface temperature are presented. The absence of significant excess of the primary cell surface temperature, as well as the absence of fires and explosions is revealed. It is concluded that the use of such electrochemical cells is safe. It is proposed to use such electrochemical cells in subscriber portable communication devices.

articleTitle: Cyclostationary Analysis of Electric Power in a Resonant Circuit under Periodic Excitation
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents an example of power analysis in parallel resonant circuit excited by current defined as periodic pulse train. The cyclostationary methodology being developed into approach to the electric power analysis, which consists in exploiting a standard set of cyclostationary characteristics such as cross correlation function and its frequency counterpart – cross spectral correlation density (CSCD). These characteristics make it possible to calculate all commonly used power quantitative measures including instantaneous, apparent and average power, power factor and others. The harmonic power distribution is investigated for the chosen low-Q resonant case. The expression for components of CSCD via current and voltage Fourier series coefficients is obtained using the known frequency response of the circuit under study.

articleTitle: Theoretical Aspects of the Creation of Artificial Intelligence Systems in Transport
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The main purpose of this article is to study the theoretical aspects of creating artificial intelligence systems in transport. The topic of this article is of high relevance in the framework of today's intensively developing technologies. These systems are widely used in almost all areas of modern life. This paper touches upon aspects of the use of artificial intelligence technologies in relation to vehicles. Studying the issue of creating artificial intelligence systems in transport. As a result of the work, such issues were considered as: the relevance of the digitalization of the transport industry; advantages of introducing information systems and technologies in transport; aspects of creating AI systems and their application in transport; advantages and key factors for integrating artificial intelligence into the transport industry. The materials of the work are based on theoretical and empirical research methods. In order to obtain the most detailed and up-to-date information, scientific materials of domestic and foreign authorship are used.

articleTitle: The Development and Analysis of a Service Model for the Traffic of a Surveillance System Operator by a Dedicated Resource of an LTE Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A mathematical model of the process of joint servicing by a dedicated resource of an isolated cell of an LTE standard network of two communication session flows for the transmission of real-time services traffic and a session flow for the transmission of elastic data traffic is constructed. It is assumed that the sources of sessions are video cameras and various telemetry devices belonging to the operator of surveillance systems using the cell resource to organize their work. The models assume that real-time service traffic has an advantage in occupying a dedicated resource over data traffic. The claimed benefit is in reducing the elastic data rate to a concentration value that corresponds to the frequency of the elastic data rate. When a free channel resource appears, the data transfer rate increases. To create conditions for differentiated servicing of incoming heterogeneous information flows, the model uses the procedure for restricting access to resource occupation. The choice of restrictions depends on the type of communication sessions and on the overall level of occupancy of the allocated resource by all incoming information flows. Using the model, definitions are given for the main indicators of servicing requests, an algorithm for their evaluation is developed, and numerical examples are given illustrating the use of the model for analyzing scenarios for differentiated servicing of heterogeneous traffic.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Uplink Non-orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA)
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Nowadays wireless communication systems use orthogonal access technologies. FDMA, TDMA and CDMA technologies that have proven themselves in cellular communication systems have been replaced by OFDMA multiple access technology. OFDMA technology is used in LTE networks and in many other standards of wireless communication systems. A modified version of OFDMA technology is also used in the new 5G new radio networks. For future 6G and beyond wireless communication systems, a new technological platform is needed to provide communication services not only to people, but also to maintain the concept of the Internet of everything. The primary problem is the increased network capacity requirements. A promising technology is NOMA non-orthogonal access technology, which is a candidate technology for inclusion in future standards of wireless communication systems. There are many varieties of NOMA technology. The main goal of this work is to investigate the potential capabilities of NOMA systems with power domain - PD-NOMA. The paper presents the results of simulation modeling to evaluate the performance of PD-NOMA systems in the uplink, which is a particularly interesting scenario for Internet of Things systems.

articleTitle: Robotic Systems in Road Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article is based on the problem of improving the quality and safety of road construction works, the introduction of advanced technologies for the mechanization of road machinery and equipment, as well as reducing the share of manual labor. The article gives examples of small innovative robotic systems that take up less space during road repair, thus allowing to unload the road transport structure, thereby having a positive impact on the economic component in several areas of work at once, such as logistics companies, and the road works themselves. The assessments of the prospects for the full automation of production processes in industry by Russian scientists are considered. The paper proposes an autonomous system for robotic control of the working body of a bulldozer when erecting a road on the canvas. The possibility of using a more modern stand-alone with laser devices. The work of the Trimble GCS900 3D system, a system of automatic control and position control of the working body, is analyzed. Examples of the most popular machines in road construction, the composition and purpose of a mini-laboratory, the functions of which are performed by a robotic installation, are given. The problem of optimal contour control is considered. As well as the reasons and factors constraining the use of industrial robots.

Author Keywords: The volume and quality of road construction
improving the safety and speed of construction.

articleTitle: Creating Quantum Circuits for Training Perceptron Neural Networks on the Principles of Grover's Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper highlights a practical research of the possibility of forming quantum circuits for training neural networks. The demonstrated quantum circuits were based on the principles of Grover's Search Algorithm. The perceptron was chosen as the architecture for the example neural network. The multilayer perceptron is a popular neural network architecture due to its scalability and applicability for solving a wide range of problems. Large scale neural networks can require significant computing resources for training purposes, therefore Grover’s quantum search algorithm could be used as a way to speed up this process, thanks to its ability of simultaneously processing multiple input values of a given function.

articleTitle: Adaptive Spectrum Monitoring Algorithm for Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: At present, the communications industry is one of the fastest-growing sectors, as well as an important component of modern society, which has led to rapid growth in demand for the radio frequency spectrum (RF). Since virtually all RF is distributed among corporations providing various communication services, it is becoming increasingly difficult to introduce new communication systems and technologies. The deficit of RF has led to the development of new communication systems aimed at the efficient use of radio frequency resources. These include the Cognitive Radio System (CRS), which makes it possible to use the RF of the primary user efficiently and without reducing the quality of service for all subscribers. In the previous article, we proposed an algorithm for implementing CRS based on models of spectral occupancy. One stage of the algorithm is spectrum monitoring. Spectrum monitoring is used to obtain actual information about the spectrum occupation. There are many scientific works aimed at detecting the signals of primary users. Due to its implementation simplicity and low complexity, the main method of signal detection is the use of an energy detector, which was implemented in our previous article. However, this approach is sensitive to various types of interference and fluctuations signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), due to the dynamics of the radio environment. A new detection algorithm using an adaptive threshold is therefore proposed. The value of the adaptive threshold is selected taking into account the noise power fluctuations, thus avoiding the disadvantages of the classical energy detector. Simulation results show that an adaptive threshold algorithm is more resistant to the dynamic changes of SNR than a classical algorithm. The new algorithm also makes it possible to increase the performance of the algorithm proposed by us for the implementation of CRS based on models of spectral occupancy.

articleTitle: Development of a Model and Algorithms for Servicing Real-Time and Data Traffic in a Cloud Computing System
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Today, modern low earth orbit (LEO) mobile satellite systems require constant data exchange with cloud computing centers located on Earth to work correctly. Moreover, there is both real-time data transmission and data that allows for a delay, this, for example, may be telemetry data. In the described model the key performance features of the conjoint traffic processing were defined. They are defined using values of probabilities of the model’s stationary states. The numerical algorithm of measuring of designed performance metrics by solving the state equations system with the help of the Gauss-Zeidel algorithm is presented. The model and the resulting algorithms can be used to assess the service quality and load levels of a small cloud computing node. One of the possible options for future research on this topic may be to restrict the access of applications for data processing to prioritize the processing of real-time applications.

articleTitle: Systematic Approach in Information Support of the «Road User-Vehicle-Road-External Environment» System
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of aspects of information interaction of the driver subsystem while driving a vehicle. The purpose of writing the paper is to publish the unified information model of interaction of the "Driver" subsystem with other subsystems of the classical "Driver-Vehicle-Road-Environment" system proposed by the author. In the article the author analyzes the information signals coming to the driver from the controlled vehicle, the road, the environment, including other participants of the road. The author builds channels of information interaction between individual subsystems "Driver - Vehicle - Road - Environment". The proposed changes the author presents in the form of a unified holistic information system "Road user -Vehicle-Road-External Environment". The scientific novelty lies in the possibility to carry out the analysis and modeling of the information exchange between the driver and other subsystems "road user - vehicle - road - environment" in order to prevent and predict road accidents.

articleTitle: Software Analyzer of Spectral Correlation Functions Using a Low-Cost SDR Receiver
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper is aimed at demonstrating the working prototype of real-time spectral correlation density (SCD) estimator being implemented as an application written in a high-level programming language Python and run on a personal computer equipped with low-cost software-defined radio receiver RTL2832U. The application supports graphical user interface and has module architecture. The outline of the main window designed with Qt framework and screenshots of the running application are shown. The multithreading implemented in the application allows changing the estimation parameters while the main subroutine is conducting an iterative SCD estimation. The test run of the prototype showed that, in case of a priory chosen limited cyclic frequency bandwidth, cyclostationary analysis in bifrequency domain can be carried out on-the-fly for an electric signal at the processing rate of more than three hundred samples per second, which was the actual sampling rate in kilohertz used for acquiring the complex envelopes of the signal.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Safe Movement of Highly Automated Vehicles by Means of Digital Road Model Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes approaches to building a digital road model that is closely integrated into an intelligent transport system and is its structural element. The use of technologies digital road model makes it possible to improve the information of automated vehicles, which is very important for their safe integration into the existing transport system. These technologies allow to provide up-to-date information not only about statistical, but also about dynamic objects. The article provides a detailed description of dynamic objects and their classification, as well as describes the levels of situational awareness and types of the standard operating environment. Examples of the physical and functional architecture of the digital road model are given.

articleTitle: Development of a Method for Researching the Occurrence of Additional Distortions in the Presence of Errors in the Digital Channel and Transformation of Different Metric Spaces
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Signals from a message source can be of various types. At the same time, for their description, appropriate models are used, which make it possible to represent the generated signals in various metric spaces that are adequate to the type of signals under consideration. So, for example, the Euclidean space is used to describe analog signals, while Hamming space is used to describe a discrete digital signal. It is obvious that the mapping of signals first in the Euclidean space and then in the Hamming space corresponds to a nonlinear transformation, part of which is the need to match the powers of the corresponding sets under the condition of a one-to-one (one-to-one) mapping and with the introduced quality criterion. The article proposes a method for analyzing the bijection of the original set and the set of signal values at the reception, corresponding to the transformation of the elements of the original signal into digital elements of the Hamming space. This method makes it possible to carry out quantitative calculations in order to select the best one-digit match (bijection) method that provides the minimum amount of additional distortions arising in the elements of the original set due to errors in the elements of the set of signal values at the reception.

articleTitle: Communication Theory Teaching Methods Using Multimedia Technologies and Application Packages
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the modern world, the use of innovative tools for distance and multimedia learning is relevant in connection with the digital transformation of the world. Future technicians should not only learn the theory of any technical discipline, but also be able to apply the knowledge gained in practice. Given the popularity of information technology, any technical specialist should learn the basics of programming and creating simulation models for further research and technical development. In this regard, the article proposes a method of teaching the course "General Theory of Communication" and related disciplines using multimedia (presentation) technologies with audio accompaniment and animation, as well as using the "MATLAB" software for laboratory work. Descriptions and software implementation of laboratory works on the topic "M-QAM signal processing in a system with MIMO and a direct conversion receiver" and visual information about the lecture course are presented.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Service Life of Paint Coatings in Aggressive Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Paint coatings are the most common type of protection of various metals from corrosion and the effects of external environmental factors in the production of vehicles. One of the main technological properties of paint coatings are adhesion and their protective ability. Phosphating can significantly affect both of these properties. The studies carried out in this work allow us to state that in case of damage to the paintwork to the metal substrate and simultaneous exposure to aggressive media (air, salt, water), due to excellent aeration, a galvanic trace element begins to appear on the damaged area. The open segment of the substrate, to which oxygen has direct access, turns into a micro cathode, and the conjugate surface, coated with paint coatings and reliably protected from oxygen access, becomes a micro anode. In the absence of protection in the form of a phosphate film on the surface of steel, corrosion processes begin to occur without any obstacles. Of the second part, when a phosphate layer is located between the substrate and the paint coatings, the electrical relationship is interrupted due to its insulating properties. The corrosion process strongly stagnates and proceeds only in individual pores of the phosphate layer. Consequently, the protection will rise with an increase in the thickness of the phosphate layer and a decrease in the number of pores in it.)

articleTitle: Analysis of Modern Methods Used to Assess the Quality of Video Sequences During Signal Streaming
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: videos are going to occupy 82% of Internet traffic by 2022, as now we can observe a trend that video streaming is taking up more and more Internet bandwidth. With video traffic skyrocketing, improvements in video encoding technology are critical for video streaming companies. Assessing the quality of video compression in terms of human perception is an important area of research. Subjective evaluations of video quality require a lot of time for experiments and are not feasible in real-time applications. Therefore, interest in the development of models for the objective evaluation of video quality has a high growth trend in recent years. The main problem of modern objective quality assessments is unreliable information provided by developers, poor correlation with the visual perception of artefacts by the end user-human. In this paper, we present an analysis of modern video quality assessments used to assess the quality of video sequences during signal streaming. This work will be useful to video compression researchers, and will also be useful in creating additional test materials, planning future experiments, and improving adaptive codecs.

articleTitle: Research of Diesel Structure-Borne Noise Using Modern Modeling Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The use of modern information technologies for modeling the of noise of an internal combustion engine makes it possible to expand the range of obtained results, which improves the quality of work on the study and reduction of engine noise and vibrations. The article presents a methodology for modeling the structure-borne noise of diesel working process in the AVL EXCITE complex. The calculation of the sound power of the 4-cylinder diesel engine (D=11 cm, S= 12.5 cm) for the full load characteristic is performed. Comparison of the calculation results with experimental data showed that in the crankshaft speeds range from 1400 to 2400 min<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, except for the 1800 min<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> mode, the difference between it is 0.7…2 dB. Thus, the use of the AVL EXCITE complex increased the accuracy of calculations of the structure-borne noise of tested 4-cylinder diesel. The contribution of individual external surfaces of engine body parts to the overall sound power level was evaluated. It was found that the cylinder block makes the greatest contribution.

articleTitle: Frequency Analysis of Sound Broadcasting Signal Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The purpose of the work is to develop algorithms for frequency analysis of spectral, rhythmic, cepstral and spectral parameters of a sound broadcasting signal (SBS), which provide consistent, with the perception characteristics of a peripheral human auditory analyzer, results and allow assessing the quality of transmission of the sound-broadcasting signal by a real signal. Traditional methods of spectral analysis of the sound-broadcasting signal, at short time intervals commensurate with individual sounds, do not provide acceptable accuracy and resolution capability. The requirements for accuracy and resolution capability of spectral analysis consistent with the capabilities of the human peripheral auditory analyzer are justified. Algorithm of signal analysis based on discrete cosine transformation (DCT) of complex represented SBS is proposed with simultaneous generation of additional compensating signal, which allows to eliminate side petals of estimation. Subsequent analysis of multiple transposed SBS allows us to bring the score closer to the accuracy of the human auditory analyzer. The resolution capability of the analysis is twice of the discrete Fourier transform (DFT). Examples of practical use of developed algorithms are given.

articleTitle: Development of Applications for Generating and Reading QR Codes for the Micro1 Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper provides an overview of barcode technology, describing the milestones of the technology evolution, with brief history outlines, depicting main points of barcode systems and highlighting emerging technologies having affected the way towards development of modern access codes. The underlined principles of QR are presented via code operations performed by example of a relatively simple code model widely known as Micro QR Model 1. The practical result obtained in the research was a simple application developed, which encodes a short piece of information into images according to the principle of Micro 1 model QR coding. Python-based encoder and decoder securely generating and processing Micro-1 codes was created. An essential part of the application code, application interface and a security block request are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Mud-Snow Layer Accumulation on Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) System Radar and Thickness Measurement of It
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Some problem is appeared during ADAS Adaptive Cruise control (ACC) system evaluation on public roads during winter usage. During others ACC tests that were done before this problem was not considered. The essence of problem is working surface of ACC radar is covered by mud and snow mix layer. Mud and snow are picked up from road surface by other traffic participants. By this layer radar start to be "blind" and ACC either stop to work or continue to work but can’t see a vehicle or other obstacles in front. It’s possible to have serious collision if second one scenario is happened. The test method is developed for comparison test of vehicles with different radar location on public roads on winter condition. Test preparation algorithm was developed. There is description of measurement equipment that is necessary for the test. It was proved how many vehicles are necessary for the test and their relative location on road during movement. Mud – snow layer thickness measurement method was developed. It was described of responsibility of each test team member during the test. Test duration and test road choice were justified to collect enough date for further analyses. Practical test will be conducted based on this method. Results will be published in separate article.

articleTitle: FBMC-OQAM Helping Pilots Application for Synchronization and Channel Estimation Sequences
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: FBMC-OQAM technology is of great interest for communication systems beyond 5G and 6G. Increasing data rate requirements need more flexibility allocation of resources used for channel estimation. In this work, an extension of the helping pilot symbol generation algorithm for estimating the frequency response of a multipath channel and synchronization in FBMC-OQAM systems for preamble sequences was considered by jointly calculating the helping pilot symbol values. simulation modeling of the described algorithm was carried out to estimate performance of this algorithm and compare it with existing solutions. Also were proposed methods for reducing computational complexity of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Recovery Accuracy of Vehicles Flow Characteristics by Video Sensor Views
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Traffic analysis using computer vision methods is an integral part of modern intelligent transport systems. Macromodels use a hydrodynamic approach, which requires intensity, density, and velocity versus time. Therefore, traffic counting based on a video surveillance system, is one of the urgent tasks. However, this issue still remains a challenge, especially with different video camera angles placement scenarios. In this paper, using the method of virtual detectors, we investigate how the video angle affects the count of vehicles for traffic analysis problems. Two video streams of highways of the city of Moscow in profile and front, received from open-access and own cameras, are taken as experimental data. Software to capture the intensity, density and velocity of traffic flows in real time has been developed.

articleTitle: The Concept of Highly Automated Vehicles Safety Monitoring in Operation Using Virtual Testing Procedures
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article formulates the main problems of development and implementation of highly automated and autonomous vehicles in the road transport infrastructure. Perspective approaches to ensure security are considered and the advantages of their application are substantiated. A scheme has been developed for predicting and ensuring a given level of safety for highly automated vehicles. The advantages and prospects of using virtual tests both at the development stage and throughout the life cycle of highly automated and autonomous vehicles are substantiated in order to monitor their safety. Siemens Prescan software is given as a test simulation tool, its functions are considered. In addition, companion programs are described that can be collectively used to monitor the safety of highly automated vehicles, autonomous vehicles in service using virtual testing.

articleTitle: Research of the Quality of Functioning of Fiber-Optical Transmission Systems on the Basis of Modern Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Methods for improving the quality of functioning fiber-optic transmission systems based on the next NGN (Next Generation Network) and future FN (Future Network) communication networks using efficient technologies for the spectral division of an optical channel in optical telecommunication systems are analyzed. A new approach to the construction methods for calculating the capacity indicators of communication lines of a DWDM system and the performance fiber-optic transmission systems (FOTS) for guaranteed quality of service QoS (Quality of Service) and QoE (Quality of Experience) in the provision multimedia services "Triple Play services" and Bandwith on Demand. The quality indicators of FOTS functioning with the use of modern optical technologies of wavelength multiplexing when introducing single-mode fibers with attenuation are considered. Based on the study optical transport communication networks, the indicators were chosen for the capacity of fiber-optic transmission systems and the spectral efficiency modulation formats based on spectral WDM (Wavelength Division Multiplexing) and DWDM (Dense WDM) technologies in the provision multimedia services. In this paper, based on the methods for calculating the capacity indicators of the lines of a DWDM system, the issues quality of indicators FOTS functioning using spectral WDM and DWDM technologies are investigated. Further, the paper provides an analysis and calculation indicators of the throughput fiber-optic communication lines and spectral modulation efficiencies based on wavelength multiplexing.

articleTitle: Features of Data Exchange of Highly Automated Public Transport with a Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents the interim results of a study of forming the functional architecture of the dispatching control system for public transport with the advent of highly automated public transport. In particular, the issue of the composition of information protocols for data exchange between a vehicle and a dispatching system were investigated. The first section analyzes and synthesizes the capabilities of modern dispatch control systems in the context of the main control systems based on open sources of information. The second section analyzes the applicability of the SAE classification to route passenger transport, taking into account the specifics of public transport operations. In the third section, the possibilities of modern automated dispatch control systems (ADCS) to switch to automatic control are considered. In the fourth section, the material presented in the first three paragraphs is used to form a list of dispatching commands, develop their format, as well as the mode of exchanging information messages between a vehicle at various levels of automation and application programs of an automated dispatching system.

articleTitle: Lorentz System Based Pseudo-Random Sequences in PAPR Reduction and Information Security Enhancement of the OFDM Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents the results of the influence of the statistical characteristics of the pseudorandom sequence generator on improving the energy efficiency and information security of the communication system with OFDM. The influence of the modulation depth of a discrete-nonlinear Lorentz system subject to quasi-resonant influences on the autocorrelation function and on the probability of passing the universal set of computer security tests FIPS-140-2 is considered. The paper describes the results of the influence of the modulation depth on the peak factor of the signals of the considered communication system with OFDM and the entropy of the transmitted information. The results presented in the work can be used in the design of the modern communication systems with OFDM in order to increase the energy efficiency and information security of the transmitted information.

articleTitle: A set of Laboratory Works on the Study of Modulated Signals of Modern Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Vector is the application programs complex developed by the Moscow Technical University of Communications and Informatics (MTUCI). It includes programs of the modulated signals vector synthesis named "Vector-VSG" and "Vector-VSA" which is aimed at the vector analysis of modern telecommunication system signals, testing of individual functional nodes, radio frequency blocks, and devices in general. The programs have a similar interface and the same principles of organization and execution. As a result of the "Vector" package development, a description of nine laboratory research performed by students using the Vector signal synthesis and analysis software package was developed.

articleTitle: New Teaching Approach on Matlab Programming for Radio Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents a new approach to the implementation of laboratory work for students that getting education in the field of radio engineering in disciplines related to the use of information technology. The practical aspects of the application of the "pipeline method of teaching", which was developed by the authors of this work earlier, are considered in the form of a methodological component and examples showing their practical implementation. The possibilities for increasing the motivational component of students are shown, which is necessary to compensate for the growing shortage of engineering staff.

articleTitle: Design and Study of an Antenna System for Receiving Telemetry Information from Spacecraft Cubesat
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The last few years can be called a period of rapid heyday in the development, manufacture and launch into space of nanosatellites, the number of which in near-earth orbits is estimated at thousands of pieces. Despite the minimum of on-board equipment, there is a very wide range of tasks they perform – scientific research, weather monitoring, obtaining photo and video materials, biological experiments, and teaching students. One of the problems of transmitting useful information from onboard is the short flight time of a spacecraft in the visibility zone of a ground station, which requires a large number of ground tracking stations. This article is devoted to the development and study of a ground tracking station, which solves the problem of pointing receiving antennas to spacecraft and receiving useful information from them.

articleTitle: The Steganographic Method of Introducing Additional Information, Resistant to Transcoding and Conversion
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In many current videos is necessary to include hidden information. It can be done with the use of steganography. Steganography is based on the limited capabilities of human senses, which is why people are not able to distinguish minor variations of colors. Based on the research of limit to human vision, here we offer a new method and test equipment for research and measure the characteristic of hiding information in the digital image. The presented steganographic method is based on Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) for the transition to the lower frequency domain. The main goal is to embed information in a digital image so that both the message and the fact of its presence are hidden. The presented method reflects the internal mechanisms of the visual system and is convenient for describing the process of image perception. The experimental results were compared with other methods and proved to be satisfactory

articleTitle: Virtual Asterisk IP-PBX Operation Studying and Exploring at the University
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A brief outline of the ITU-T concept of fixed mobile Future Networks is given. According to the concept, Future Networks are to support the virtualization of network resources. Studying the principles of virtualizing telecommunications systems and communications networks is a part of Infocomm Technologies and Communications Networks educational programme at the Moscow Technical University of Communications and Informatics. The students are taught how to install, set up and operate a virtual Asterisk IP-PBX. They study such additional features as call transfer and pickup, creating an interactive voice response, videoconferences. They also explore the interaction of the Asterisk IP-PBX and the public switched telephone network as well as the quality of service in IP telephony.

articleTitle: Calculation of Radiation Characteristics of a Circular Waveguide Covered with Thermal Protection and Plasma Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A mathematical model of an aerospace antenna of a space vehicle on the descending trajectory taking into account thermal protection and plasma layer has been developed. The results of numerical calculation of losses of electromagnetic energy in the heated thermal protection of a circular waveguide and plasma layer are presented. An algorithm for calculating the mathematical model has been suggested. The calculation has been performed to determine the influence of a change in thickness and electric parameters of the thermal protection and plasma layer on the radiation pattern and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research of the Level of Driver Involvement in the Management of a Highly Automated Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article describes an experiment aimed at solving the problem of assessing the degree of driver distraction from driving tasks while driving in a highly automated vehicle (HAV). Based on the results of the experiment, the basic concept of an algorithm for assessing the driver’s involvement in the control process when driving in a HAV has been developed. The developed concept can be applied to the design of various kinds of interfaces used for cars with adaptive driver assistance systems or having solutions of varying degrees of automation. Understanding the processes inside the car interior will allow you to better assess the quality of the driver’s work, as well as adapt the settings of automation systems to the psychotype of a particular driver, which will create the best operating conditions for the vehicle and, as a result, increase the level of safety on public roads.

Author Keywords: involvement in the process of driving
the level of degradation of attention

articleTitle: Analytical Model the Data Transmission Medium of the On-Board Information System in the Ethernet Standard
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the tasks arising in the design of on-board information control systems is the construction of a communication network for data transmission between its components. The most important indicator of the quality of functioning of the information and computer network is the delivery time of the transmitted messages, the duration of which should not exceed the specified limits. The paper considers mathematical models of communication networks of on-board information systems using the mathematical apparatus of the queuing theory. The model bases on the assumption that the network uses the Ethernet standard and the parameters of the input streams and the time of the streams may have different distributions. A model of the transmission medium of the onboard information system and a model of the on-board server in the form of an open queuing network was developed. The use of specialized software for calculating the probabilistic and temporal characteristics of such networks makes it possible to determine not only their average values, but also maximum values, which may exceeded only for a small-predetermined proportion of all requests entering the network.

articleTitle: Determination of Instant Social Risk for a Moving Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents theoretical approaches to the development of a methodology for instant assessment of social transport risk arising on public roads. The method of determining instantaneous social risk, methods of obtaining and transmitting information necessary for its calculation are considered. The calculation of the instantaneous social risk for a moving vehicle is performed for an instant assessment of road safety. This method can be used both for a comprehensive safety assessment and for creating control algorithms for highly automated vehicles. Thanks to this, it is possible to take actions in advance that will avoid the occurrence of emergencies and accidents.

Author Keywords: calculation of the conflict of motor traffic flow

articleTitle: Multiphase PWM Signal Generator Model Design for Effective Class D Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article describes the design of a multiphase pulse width modulation (PWM) signal generator model for use in a high-performance class D switching amplifier. Sigma-delta modulation (SDM) is used for additional mathematical processing. In this article architecture of proposed generator model and operation principles of each block are described. The influence of the order of the SDM and the number of phases of the multiphase PWM on the characteristics of the signal at the amplifier output using the developed model is investigated. It also considers the relationship between the clock frequencies of individual blocks, depending on the sampling rate of the input digital signal.

articleTitle: Method of Storing Information Based on Unit Coding
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The study explores effective ways to compress information. Criteria providing the choice of acceptable methods of signal compression are substantiated. Methods of compression are revealed that provide maximum entropy due to the elimination of psychophysical redundancy of information. The degree of compression in methods that exclude only statistical redundancy and the number of repetitions of information in the signal is qualitatively established. The unsuitability of the use of irreversible compression methods for the transmission of the reference signal has been substantiated. Methods for the classical increase in entropy are considered. The main disadvantage of the known methods of efficient coding is noted. It attempts to compress information that has already been compressed. The study proposes to go to the original form - a unitary code before the information compression procedure. On the basis of the material presented earlier, a presentation method is proposed and a method for storing information without increasing the storage volume is described. This can be achieved through the use of unitary coding. The required storage volume is set, determined by the required number of bits of the unitary code of the maximum of the stored numbers. The advantages and disadvantages of switching to a unitary code are considered. The principles of adding new information to the final unitary code are determined. The factors determining the maximum amount of data influencing the processing time of the file are substantiated. The fundamentals of the differential approach are proposed, which make it possible to increase the conversion speed from a unitary code. More research is needed to improve the storage density of compressed information.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Technologies in Air Transport Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The combination of current trends in Information Technologies (rapid progress of virtual and augmented reality technologies) and in Air Traffic Control (continuous descent/climb trajectories and area navigation) makes it necessary and possible to replace outdated methods in the practice of air traffic controllers with augmented reality approaches. This paper describes an experimental program designed to prove the feasibility of using virtual / augmented reality tools in Air Traffic Control, and an augmented reality app used for training students in Air Traffic Control. The obtained results of the experimental program indicate the high efficiency of the use of virtual and augmented reality technologies in future tasks of Air Traffic Control.

articleTitle: Theoretical Approaches to Improving the Efficiency of Business Processes of Passenger Transport Enterprises Through the Introduction of Modern Digital Technologies : Theoretical Aspects of Artificial Intelligence Systems Development for Transportation Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The widespread introduction of digital technologies in all spheres of activity opens up prospects for a significant increase in the efficiency and quality of various technological processes of the enterprise. This article discusses theoretical approaches to the development of digital models and solutions aimed at increasing the level of automation of the main production business processes at a transport enterprise (drawing up work schedules for drivers and work orders, registration and issuance of waybills, distribution of rolling stock along routes, organization and conduct of medical examinations of drivers, dispatching traffic control of vehicles on routes).

articleTitle: Requirements for Intelligent Safety Monitoring Systems of Vehicles and Infrastructure Using Gas Motor Fuel (Natural Gas, Hydrogen)
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Existing technological trends in using of various types of gas motor fuel (GMF) on transport require more thorough control of the technical condition of motor vehicles running on GMF (compressed natural gas and compressed hydrogen) and infrastructure facilities. The main problems are related to the increased danger of gas motor fuel due to the occurrence of possible leaks and non-compliance with the requirements for the operation of gas equipment. The article discusses the causes of emergencies, measures to prevent them, the requirements for intelligent systems for monitoring and preventing accidents and disasters due to leakage of combustible gases GMF. To analyze the main causes of accidents on GMF vehicles and on infrastructure, the method of constructing and analyzing fault trees (FTA) is used. According to preliminary estimates, when creating and using intelligent safety monitoring systems (ISMS), it will be possible to reduce the probability of failures leading to GMF leaks on vehicles and objects of infrastructure by about 15-20%.

articleTitle: Circuit Design of a Frequency Synthesizer Device for High-Speed Data Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper analyzes the circuitry solutions and obtains the results of modeling a frequency synthesizer circuit based on a phase-locked loop (PLL), which contains the following components: phase detectors (PD), voltage-controlled oscillators (VCO), and a counter-frequency divider (C -FD). The main components of the PLL: PD, VCO and C-FD are implemented according to the classic CMOS-circuitry. The proposed solutions for the implementation of components based on CMOS-transistors with design standards of 65 nm made it possible to create a model of a frequency synthesizer required for the implementation of onboard devices using OFDM technology.

articleTitle: Development of the Architecture of the On-Board Assistance System for the Driver of a City Bus Based on the Use of a Fuzzy Logic Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Urban passenger transport is currently considered by the administrations of large cities and megalopolises as the main tool for improving the difficult transport situation that has arisen due to the uncontrolled increase in the level of automation of the population. The problem, in this case, is the need to dramatically improve the quality of public transport services, by improving the regularity of vehicles on a schedule. This article discusses a bus driver assistance system that provides automatic control of a passenger vehicle movement on a schedule. As a driver assistance system, an intelligent telematic controller based on the fuzzy logic technique, discussed in this article.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Processing by Tensor Algebra Means in Condition of Movement Along Complex Roads
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to research related to the processing of uncertainty by means of tensor algebra in the conditions of the road traffic control based on wireless sensor networks determine complex controlling road infrastructure. The organization of traffic on difficult roads is one of the key challenges of the transportation industry. The solution of this problem occurs under conditions of uncertainty, which may appear at different levels of the traffic control process. The article offers a classification of uncertainty in a complex dynamic system. By the example of organizing the interaction of smart controllers in an electronic coupling, the author shows the results of applying the methods of tensor network analysis to obtain the computational base of electronic coupling network interaction of intelligent (smart) vehicle controllers. Examples of processing uncertainty of different types using the apparatus of fuzzy sets and tensor basis are considered. Tensor equations provide efficient processing of big data, obtaining information in-real-time mode, the stability of “Intelligent electronic hitch” system to changes in the topology of the connection of controllers and changes in soft- and hard- components of the connection. The use of tensors in the computational basis of the intelligent electronic hitch makes it possible successful implementation of embedded AI at the level of an intelligent (smart) controller. The results obtained in the article show that the computational basis on the example of the electronic hitch algorithm can be used in smart controller systems of any level of complexity based on wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Reference Node for Forming the Time Scale of a Coherent Public Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article is a logical continuation and specification of the works of the authors on the justification and use of the core of the time-frequency support of the transport network as the basis for the synchronization system for 5G and 6G networks. It considers the possibilities of implementing the reference synchronization node of a coherent public communication network - the coherent primary reference time and clock (cnPRTC), on domestic equipment. It is based on the ITU-T Recommendations both in terms of the structure of the cnPRTC and in terms of the accuracy characteristics of the output frequency and time signals. The norms for the permissible errors of the main units are given and their feasibility is shown.

Author Keywords: methods of comparison and distribution of time scales

articleTitle: Development of an Interval Method for Queue Analysis in Queueing Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the peculiarities of traffic of multiservice communication networks, its processing in queuing systems and interval methods of traffic analysis. As an analyzed random variable, the number of applications arriving in the system at constant time intervals equal to the mathematical expectation of application processing times is considered. The generalized Hinchin-Pollachek formula for average queue values occurring when processing flows of common kind requests is given. The generalized formula specifies the dependence of average queue values on the variance and correlation properties of a given random variable, at different values of the system load factor. Group Poisson flows are given as an example of a flow for which there is no correlation component. The formula for group Poisson flows of requests is considered. For such flows, the average queue value, for a given system load, is completely determined by the variance of the number of applications at their service intervals. It is shown that the processing of applications is cyclic, and there is always no queue at the last interval of the active part of each cycle. For a stationary flow of applications with finite mathematical expectation and variance, formulas are given from which it follows that when incoming applications are placed at time intervals distant from the beginning of each cycle, their contribution to the average queue value decreases. The queue reaches its maximum value if all applications are concentrated at the beginning of cycles. The development of the interval method of queue analysis was the determination of the number of requests in the time intervals between neighboring served requests leaving the queue. The obtained relations are fundamental because they show that if the conditions of stationarity, ergodicity and convergence of the covariance function are satisfied, the conditional average values of queues in a single-channel queuing system are completely determined by the variance and the sum of covariances of the number of applications received in the time intervals between neighboring serviced applications.

articleTitle: Trajectory Correction of Autonomous Objects in the Presence of Restrictions
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The traffic safety of an automatic transport facility is one of the most pressing and interesting problems. The use of neural networks to solve this problem is the most promising development. The problem of constructing the trajectory of a transport object in the event of a dead-end obstacle is described in our article. A model of the control system is proposed, in which the constantly updated information received from the sensors is analyzed. At the same time, it should be noted that this information contradicts some unchanged data that are taken from global sensors. An external object that can change the rules for the movement of vehicles in the current conditions conducts data analysis. Based on the results of this analysis, it is proposed, according to a certain algorithm, to change the route of the autonomous object in accordance with the shortest option for returning to the original trajectory. The article defines a neural network according to the energy function that minimizes the cost of movement and ensures the safety of an autonomous object.

articleTitle: Conceptual Model of Perspective Carrier Ethernet Transport Communication Network Control System for Public Joint Stock Company «Russian Railways»
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The aim of this paper is designing a conceptual transport communication network control system using Carrier Ethernet technology for ensuring a required functioning efficiency in view of forehanded and reasonable making the management decisions for transport communication network under the conditions of high dynamics of state transition and taking into account characteristics of Carrier Ethernet technology. Therefore, for the purpose of quality-guaranteed service provisioning a conceptual model of three-level control system for transport communication network that designates place and role of the multi-agent management system is provided. For achieving the given problem an algorithmic structure of this conceptual model functioning is also created. Methods: designing of the conceptual model and its algorithmic structure is performed using fundamentals of complex process control, multi-agent systems of distributed objects control and simulation modeling principles. The modeling results of particular processes are obtained within the proposal transport communication network control conception. Results: the obtained conceptual model of transport communication network control system that applies control and management processes to the states of Carrier Ethernet network elements (Operation, Administration and Maintenance principles, OAM) and developed algorithmic structure of this model are mathematically described. Besides, authors give an evaluation of the aim achieving efficiency according to which it has been determined the rise of realization operability with regarding to processes for transport network state management and control (due to using the original control and management mechanisms for the states of transport network based on Carrier Ethernet) and on-time delivering of control information for the transport network reconfiguration. The practical significance is that the proposed model is differ from other models by an opportunity of including in it a complex of perspective models for Carrier Ethernet transport network functioning and management with OAM mechanisms that allow to form the network control system using Carrier Ethernet instruments so that this system satisfies to the requirements of control cycle realization operability and makes it possible to minimize a financial and technical resources

articleTitle: Intelligent Disabled Passenger Support System
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the modern world, technologies associated with systems for generating and processing signals in the field of communication are ubiquitous. They are used for different purposes. In Russia, as in the rest of the world, much attention is paid to social innovation. Many people with disabilities participate independently in public life without assistance. but sometimes they can get into critical situations while on board an aircraft or any ground vehicle. A person may become ill and need urgent help from people around him who do not speak sign language. In this case, a sign language recognition system and its translation into text or sound, located on a smartphone, are required. The article describes the development of a software package for recognizing static and dynamic dactyls of the Russian language using neural network methods of machine learning, provides the architecture of the developed neural network of direct distribution, the results of training and test experiments on recognizing all dactyls of the Russian sign language, both static and dynamic.

Author Keywords: intelligent recognition system for static and dynamic dactyls

articleTitle: Methods for Evaluating Network Characteristics on Blockchain-V2X System Nodes
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The analysis of potential load on the blockchain node of the Internet of Vehicles and the evaluation of the possibility of application of blockchain technology is carried out in the work. The work discusses concepts and approaches for building the architecture of Internet of Vehicles with the integration of blockchain technology. Within the framework of the ongoing research, the main principles of constructing a testbench with integration of blockchain networks Ethereum and Waves, research methodology and analysis of the obtained results are reflected in the work. The paper detailed the main principles underlying the study and considered scenarios for the use of blockchain technology as a special case of distributed ledger technologies.

articleTitle: Visual Environment for Mathematical Modeling of Traffic Flows
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper is devoted to the development of software for mathematical modeling of traffic flows, that allows to set initial conditions via a browser-based user interface as well as visually represent the results. The main application of the visual environment is to create a convenient way to run numerical experiments using the cellular automata-based models created by the authors and visualize the results. User interface allows to set initial conditions and modeling parameters, build the computational domain (road network) in an intuitive way and to send these data for computation. Visualization module receives data files from the computational module and renders them, representing them in the form of step-by-step car movement with traffic lights, intersections, marking, etc.

articleTitle: Video-Based Method of Markovian Matrix Recovery for Road Intersection Control
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problems of controlling traffic flows on street and road networks of large cities are relevant both for practical engineering activity and in theoretical terms. Known network models are reduced to numerical schemes for hydrodynamic analogs used in the theory of traffic flows. This article discusses the structure of megapolis traffic flow model, created under the leadership of Prof. A.P. Buslaev on the example of Moscow at the end of the last century. The most difficult module of this structure for realization is the information on redistribution of flows in the nodes of the transport network graph. In the model, it is proposed to represent this information in the form of a Markov matrix. The paper presents a methodology for restoring coefficients of this matrix based on input and output flow intensities. The intensity values of the flows are detected automatically using special software for pattern recognition when processing a video file of the flows at the studied intersection.

articleTitle: Distributed DVB-T2 Standard Broadcast Quality Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper is devoted to the development of a technical solution, patented in Russia, for monitoring the quality of single frequency networks to provide reliable and uninterrupted TV and radio broadcasting in DVB-T2 standard on the territory of Russia. The proposed client-server architecture of the monitoring platform uses the necessary hardware, including bit error rate sensors based on programmable receivers combined with single-board microcomputers, implemented on SoC (System-on-Chip) processors.

articleTitle: Analog Self-Learning Automata of Radio Engineering Devices Based on Cyber-Physical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
