abstract: The article defines the principles of organizing analog self-learning automata based on cyber-physical networks and their application in radio engineering devices. A model is presented that generates parametric, structural and flow dynamics of changes in the states of a technical system. The possibilities of analog technologies are shown, which can significantly increase the efficiency of distributed control networks for the functional units of radio engineering devices. A model of three-valued sequential parametric logic is presented, which makes it possible to implement hardware algorithms based on analog automata that perform hardware functional-logical transformations of signals without switching to digital and software processing. Examples are considered that show the effectiveness of the use of analog self-learning devices for the tasks of extracting signals from interference and identifying objects. The spline signal generator shows the possibility of generating signals of a given shape in the frequency range up to tens of MHz, which makes it possible to use it in the synthesizers of stimulating signals of built-in control devices. High-speed analog memory in conjunction with a spline generator underlies the creation of self-learning automata for extracting a useful signal from noise. The presented solutions are not an alternative to digital technologies. They show new, unclaimed possibilities of analog technology, which in some cases significantly increase the efficiency and reliability of radio systems, reduce their design complexity.

articleTitle: Evaluation of V2X Communication Architecture Characteristics Based on Loss Queueing System with Bandwidth Sharing Discipline
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers a loss multi-channel queueing system modeling a cell in a wireless network. The model may be applicable in 4G/5G networks. Calls of different classes are serviced in the cell under a bandwidth sharing algorithm called the multiple fractional channel reservational policy. According to this algorithm, a number of channels is reserved for calls of certain classes. An approach is known to compute an approximate value the loss probabilities for calls of each class. The approach is based on the formulas derived under the assumption that the service time of a call is distributed exponentially. We study by simulation the accuracy of the approach generalization for the case of general service distribution time. We proposes an approximate approach to evaluate the stationary state probabilities, the loss probability and the average number of serviced jobs for First Come First Displaced protocol. We estimate the accuracy of this approach.

articleTitle: Investigation of SAR Resolution at Translational and Rotational Motion of Interlinked Antenna Phase Centers
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents a study of assessing angular resolution of radar systems with a synthetic aperture created via translational and rotational motion of an interlinked set of the phase centers of real antennae. The research also deals with an overview of relevant studies regarding the ways to enhancing the angular resolution evaluation of synthetic-aperture radar systems via creation of a synthetic aperture in circumstances where the rotational motion of the phase center of a real antenna or the set of interlinked antennae. The performed analytical studies yielded mathematical equations describing the law of variation of distance between a stationary ground-based target and an interlinked set of receiving and transmitting radar antennae with the radar system being in an arbitrary position. In addition, for cases where a point source target being detected in the front-looking and side-looking modes, the analysis yielded equations describing potential linear resolving power of radar systems for a chosen method of synthetic aperture creation. The simulation modeling has been used for proving mathematical models of generation and processing of a trajectory signal with selected positions of a point-source target relative to the airborne radar carrier.

articleTitle: Analysis of Network Traffic in Telecommunication Networks of a Transport Company
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In modern times, cyber attacks are one of the main business problems. Classical protection only by an antivirus program and a firewall over the past ten years have been recognized as insufficient and incapable of providing reliable information protection. Intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS) are the next step in the development of network protection systems. The purpose of this article is to introduce the developed intrusion detection system (IDS) based on anomalies, capable of quickly detecting and classifying various attacks. The proposed IDS uses a backpropagation multilayer perceptron to study system behavior. The training of the system was based on the UNSW-NB-15 dataset and the results are consistent with the results obtained.

articleTitle: Comparative Efficiency of Stabilizing Actions on the Controlled Lorentz System
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the determination of the comparative energy efficiency of stabilizing quasi-resonant and inertial influences on the parameters of a controlled discrete-nonlinear Lorentz system with dynamic chaos. It is shown that fluctuations causing deviations of the discrete-nonlinear Lorentz system from equilibrium states lead to changes in the quasi-resonant frequency and the efficiency of inertial stabilizing effects. It is found that the efficiency of stabilizing inertial actions on the parameter b of the controlled discrete-nonlinear Lorentz system increases with an increase in the fluctuation deviation of the system from equilibrium states. The conditions are determined under which stabilizing inertial actions become energetically more favorable than quasi-stationary actions on the parameters of a discrete-nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Multichannel Optical Fibers Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The few-mode multicore optical fibers efficiency increase task in general concept of multichannel optical fibers is being raised. Multichannel fibers efficiency optimization task is being formulated including optimization in strict and broad terms. Transmission, spatial and structural parameters are being considered. The efficiency improvement approach is being systematized in the concepts of applicability, optimization and adaptivization. The multi-criteria optimization problem is solved by ranking criteria, combining criteria into a generalized scalar target function, finding Pareto-optimal estimates, etc. Due to the complexity of the generalized optimality criteria choice, in the practice of telecommunications, a gradual increase in the technical means efficiency is carried out according to certain particular criteria - optimization in quality. Based on the accepted concept of rational behavior - applicability, optimization and adaptivization, the type of performance indicator is selected. A multichannel optical fiber construction design two-criterion optimization solution example is given.

articleTitle: Determination of the Coefficient Conflict of Traffic Flow in Real Time by Means of Intelligent Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the method of calculating the conflict of motor traffic flow (hereinafter referred to as conflict). The factors used in the calculation of conflict are described, as well as possible combinations of factors that may arise are determined, favorable and unfavorable factors are determined. An example of calculating the conflict coefficient for a section of a highway is also presented.

articleTitle: On the Estimation of the ICI in OFDM in Conditions of Multipath Doppler Spreading and Carrier Frequencies Offset
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we consider the negative simultaneous effect of fast Relay fading in the channel and mutual "frequency shifts of subcarrier" subchannels between the transmitting and receiving sides of the channel, causing a violation of orthogonality between the signals of individual subchannels of the OFDM system. Violation of orthogonality is manifested by the appearance of a mutual interference signal on the receiving side of the channel in each OFDM subchannel. The paper evaluates the joint effect of fast fading and frequency shifts on the magnitude of transient interference between subchannels (ICI).

articleTitle: Development of a Microstrip Coupler with Reduced Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is aimed at solving the problem of miniaturization of power dividers that perform their work at low frequencies. The design of a coupler with reduced dimensions due to the installation of artificial transmission lines instead of conventional segments is described. Such artificial lines have a similar set of frequency characteristics, which allows them to be installed in devices and at the same time receive minimal performance losses. The results of not only modeling, but also the experiment confirmed that the proposed design provides power division in equal proportions at a given center frequency, but in a smaller frequency band, which is a disadvantage of miniaturization. The proposed design occupies 4 times less area on the substrate.

articleTitle: Methodology for Assessing the Level of Threats Based on a Limited Set of Data While Ensuring the Safety of On-Board Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In order to ensure the operational and effective safety of on-board systems created for their offline use, it is necessary to apply methods of forecasting threats and choosing the optimal strategy for preventing their consequences. Threats to economic security regarding the life cycle of on-board systems created in the digital economy are usually determined by the level and probability of external, influencing factors that determine the stability and operation of the support system for their life cycle, as which the economic system is considered. From the point of view of systems theory and system analysis, these factors are commonly referred to as environmental state variables. They are random in nature and, when mathematically described, can be continuous, discrete, or categorical. Continuous variables, when they are registered, are represented in the form of graphs or register diagrams. But for statistical and mathematical processing, they are translated into a table format or a discrete form, which, in fact, reduces them to a specific form. Discrete values of environmental variables are recorded in the form of tables or numerical sequences. Categorical variables have the meaning of logical or Boolean values and are registered in the form of tables. The prediction of categorical variables, based on the mathematical definition of safety, must be made by assessing the probability of their manifestation and impact on the life cycle support system of on-board systems as complex technical systems. The main problem in this case is the insufficient volume of statistical data to obtain estimates with a sufficient level of confidence and a tight decision-making time. The presented paper presents a Bayesian approach and a method for assessing the likelihood of threats on a limited set of data flow. Given the universal nature of the presented methodological approach to assessing the level of threats on a limited set of data in relation to assessing the safety of the on-board systems life cycle support system, it is possible to obtain its current assessments and, based on them, timely develop the necessary measures to adjust organizational, organizational, resource, technical and technological processes in the system life cycle.

Author Keywords: On-board systems life cycle support system

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Joint Interaction of Automatic Emergency Braking and Adaptive Cruise Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A test procedure for the joint interaction of the automatic emergency braking system (AEBS) and adaptive cruise control (ACC) has been developed. To evaluate the effectiveness of the AEBS and ACC systems, two types of test scenarios are proposed: "direct automatic braking" and "sudden appearance of an obstacle". An experimental study was carried out using the developed methodology for Toyota RAV4, Hyundai Tucson, Volvo XC40, Nissan X-Trail cars of 2019. Test runs were conducted at NAMI's Testing Center in daylight on a dry asphalt pavement. The model of an EVT light vehicle according to the ISO 19206-1 standard was used as a vehicle target. A comparison of braking algorithms in front of a fixed obstacle by the AEBS and ACC systems is presented. Parametric recording and test results are given when the test object moves in the ACC mode behind the leader vehicle. The influence of the distance to the leader vehicle and the speed of the lane change by the leader vehicle on the efficiency of ACC and AEBS when braking in front of a fixed obstacle has been established.

articleTitle: The Use of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) as an Auxiliary Factor in Planning Transportation Routes : Theoretical Aspects of Artificial Intelligence Systems Development for Transportation Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: the development of digital technologies for transport opens up new ways to solve classic transport problems. An important task is to determine and increase the average speed of the traffic flow. Information about the average flow rate makes it possible to effectively plan routes in urban agglomerations. The article considers and analyzes the factors influencing the average speed of vehicles (ATS) on the road network (RN) of an urban agglomeration. The article proposes the use of artificial intelligence to determine the degree of significance of each factor, as well as solving the problem of finding the average speed of the traffic flow.

articleTitle: Additive High-Speed Synchronization Techniques in PLL Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An overview of the methods of high-speed synchronization of devices based on phase-lock loop (PLL) systems is presented, such as: nonlinear control, frequency discrimination, frequency sweeping, bandwidth widening, program processing. The results of a study of the operation in the process of initial synchronization for two high-speed synchronization structures - a globally linearized synchronization system (GLSS) and a PLL system with a phase-frequency detector and a charge pump circuit (CPPLL) - are presented. In the course of simulation modeling, the advantage of GLSS in speed compared to CPPLL is shown, which can reach 10 times or more at frequency detunings that significantly exceed the system loop gain.

articleTitle: Using the Poly-Gaussian Models to Represent non-Gaussian Signals and Noises
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Described representation non-Gaussian signals and noise through the use of poly-Gaussian models. A poly-Gaussian representation of random signals and non-Gaussian noise in discrete, continuous and discrete-continuous forms is given. It is shown that in order to use poly-Gaussian models, it is also necessary to obtain poly-Gaussian representations of arbitrary densities of the probability distribution. A description of the Gaussian spectra of non-Gaussian processes is given. The properties of poly-Gaussian random processes are described, in particular, the relationship between the parameters of the mixture and the components for the one-dimensional and finite-dimensional cases. Continuous-time poly-Gaussian processes are considered. It is shown that direct methods for finding multidimensional functions of poly-Gaussian processes are based on the use of multidimensional probability distribution densities of random processes. The results of modeling the found distribution densities are presented. It is shown that knowledge of one-dimensional distributions allows one to determine the mathematical expectation, two-dimensional - the mixed moment of the second order.

Author Keywords: multidimensional function of a polygaussian process

articleTitle: The Use of Computer Training Systems in Distance Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Information and communication technologies in the context of the Industrial Revolution 4.0 are used in all industries. In the context of COVID-19 pandemic and the shift to distance learning, computer hardware and software systems are an effective tool for the successful implementation of the training process in the universities. Virtual laboratories, simulators, test computer systems are the components of the virtual educational environment of the universities. Today these tools contain a specific multimedia element - a virtual robot assistant. Student’s interaction with a virtual assistant should be comfortable and provide the successful educational process. The authors examined several aspects of effective student’s interaction with the multimedia components of the interface of the computerized learning environment. The results of the conducted experiment can be used by developers of computer virtual laboratories, simulators, experimental research stands, test computer systems, a component of which is a virtual robot assistant, to optimize the processes of educational activities distance learning included.

Author Keywords: the training process in the universities COVID-19

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of the HHO Gas Power Unit for the Development of an Electronic Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the problem of controlling a gas-diesel engine is considered, presented as well as the results of calculation and database establishment for the control unit are discussed. With the help of AVL Boost software, data on the relationship between turbocharger pressure, diesel quantity, and the amount of HHO added to the cycle is created. The amount of HHO gas is injected into the intake manifold from 0 to 40%, and the amount of diesel fuel is reduced to maintain a constant amount of heat supplied into the cycle. The results show that when the ratio of gas HHO in the fuel mixture changes from 0 to 20%, the engine performance decreases slightly (less than 10%) but decreases significantly from 20 to 40% of gas HHO. In addition, the results also present that the amount of soot, carbon monoxide, and carbon dioxide emissions decreases, at the same time, the amount of nitrogen oxides and hydrocarbon emissions increases with the addition of gas HHO.

articleTitle: Analysis of Head Injury Criterion in Case of Accidents in Road Transport for Using in Intelligent Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Scientific Technical Center "Special Vehicles" of the Moscow Polytechnic University has been conducting research in the field of ensuring the safety of the crew of automotive vehicles for more than 40 years. The specialists of our center paid attention to the fact that, due to revision in the STANAG 4569, maximum permissible safety criteria HIC was reduced by 4 times to 250 units, while the old maximum permissible value of 1000 remained in civilian standards. Such mismatch can be explained by the fact that the STANAG 4569 is regularly reviewed and updated, in contrast to the civil standard, and also by the fact that the criterion does not have a clearly justified unchanged limit value. The authors of this article have repeatedly raised the issue of the incorrectness of the HIC criterion used and its critical values. As a result of the research, it was found out that the injury safety determined by the HIC does not correspond to the injury safety determined by the Wayne State curve, which is referred to by the developers of this criterion. The results can be used in intelligent systems to support decision-making on the selection parameters of road safety systems using artificial intelligence technologies.

articleTitle: Microscopic Traffic Prediction for Automated Driving
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The methodology of the microscopic traffic prediction of microscopic traffic situation around of an automated driving vehicle moving in mixed traffic flow firstly introduced at this conference in 2021 is studied. In particular, we have analyzed the following features of the microscopic traffic prediction: (i) The use of only some limited numbers of vehicles in actual microscopic traffic situations for the prediction of the turning right of the automated vehicle at the unsignalized city intersection. (ii) The effect of the uncertainty of the data in the microscopic traffic situations on the accuracy of the microscopic traffic prediction. (iii) Other possible application scenarios of the microscopic traffic prediction. (iv) Requirements for a microscopic traffic model used for the microscopic traffic prediction.

articleTitle: Methods of Radar Image Processing to Increase the Probability of Detecting a Ship’s Track and Estimating its Absolute Speed
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, methods of processing radar images to increase the probability of detecting a ship’s trace are considered. The article takes into account the impact of various types of noise affecting the probability of detection. Various methods of digital processing are considered, such as: the use of the Lee filter, the use of the Sobel operator for edge detection, as well as the method of complex exposure based on contrast with gamma correction and the search for boundaries to increase the contrast of the image. Modeling was carried out in a package of application programs for solving technical computing problems and the most effective method for solving the problem of detecting the ship’s trace was identified. A method for determining the azimuthal displacement of a vessel relative to its wake and estimating the absolute speed based on automatic detection of the ship’s wake is also proposed.

articleTitle: The Smart City Project as a Basis for the Development of New Technologies to Provide People with Limited Mobility with an Accessible Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the theoretical foundations and practice of implementing a smart city project in Russia. The implementation of such projects is carried out not only in Russia. This direction of urban economy optimization is in demand in many cities around the world. Digitalization is actively used as the basis of the smart city project to improve the efficiency of urban governance and the quality of public services, to promote the transformation of the urban environment. The implementation of the Smart City project is based on technologies such as the Internet of Things, great data, cloud computing and artificial intelligence. Many cities have formed unique smart city projects, applied visualization technologies, online offices and online training, transport logistics and so on. Thus, the benefits of smart cities have recently been widely used including to prevent the COVID-19 pandemic for example, the introduction of electronic vaccination certificates and QR codes. However not all smart city projects are measurable that is necessary to assess the effectiveness of the project and to compare data on the cities. The article offers a tool for evaluating the effectiveness of the introduction of new technologies to provide an accessible environment for people with limited mobility.

articleTitle: Seismic Resistance of Optical Overhead Communication Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article presents the results of calculations of vibrations of optical fibre cables installed by means of cable fixtures located in tunnels and collectors exposed to seismic effects. Optical fibre cables fixtures subjected to transverse vibrations under the action of inertial forces during earthquakes are considered as different boundary conditions. After calculating the response of the optical fibre cable to the seismic impact, an assessment is given of the validity of the use of limit tensions and fastening methods in the design of cable fixtures, taking into account their safe load levels and the conditions of their stability.

Author Keywords: joint vibrations of cables and cable fixtures

articleTitle: Configurable Plasma Antenna with Laser Control
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The concept of creating configurable plasma antennas controlled by laser radiation is proposed. The working efficiency of the proposed concept was experimentally confirmed by studying a system of loop antennas, in the circuit of which a photoresistor was used as a semiconductor element. We have studied the reflection coefficient variation of such antennas in the range between 10 and 18000 MHz during exposure of the semiconductor element by λ=450 nm of variable intensity. It was demonstrated that loop antenna reflection coefficient changes along with the variation of intensity of the laser radiation, falling on the photoresistor surface. This may give us an opportunity to control the alignment of the antenna with the radio-receiving path.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Estimating the Spatial Frequency Characteristics of Cameras Based on Generative Random Sequences
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Cameras have become ubiquitous in our daily lives. The task of measuring and verifying the camera’s declared characteristics is of increasing importance. Current measurement methods range from subjective assessments using a large number of experts to more stringent characteristics, such as the determination of the modulation transfer function. Methods used last ten years have proven successful and reliable results. However, the question of how the current computational methods improve the performance of the camera has received much less attention, especially in the conditions of the test. A significant problem is a fact that the measuring instruments used in the test are standardized and do not change between measurements. In this paper, new a generative table-based measurement approach that allows you to create random initial measurement conditions. This new method opens up opportunities for improving the quality assessment of the camera’s work and providing real characteristics. The method is based on random sequences and cannot be deceived by processing algorithms inside the current software of the camera. The method is suitable to assess compression implementations in closed systems

articleTitle: Simulation of Digital and Analog Spatial Filtering of VHF Signals in Channel with Losses due to Multipple Diffraction
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper describes digital antenna arrays (DAA) equipped with directional elements for spatial filtering in the azimuthal and elevation planes. In particular, the digital beamforming is investigated for VHF communication channels in the range below 1 GHz, taking into account the occurrence of obstacles in the path of direct propagation. Thus the paper presents the results of simulation of the signal propagation in the VHF range depending on diffraction. It is assumed that a symmetrical dipole is used on the transmitting side, and the Yagi-Uda directional antenna is used on the receiving digital antenna array. The circular and semi-dodecahedral geometries of the arrangement of the elements of the receiving digital antenna array are modeled. The bit error rate is estimated depending on the transmitter power. The Epstein-Peterson method is described in conjunction with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) single knife-edge obstacle model for calculating multiple diffraction losses. The study was conducted for thirteen isolated knife-edge obstacles located along a propagation path of 70 km.

articleTitle: Practical Implementation of an EV Propulsion System Components Control and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The present article is closely connected to a relevant development trend in the automobile industry which is aimed at implementation and operation of electric vehicles. These vehicles are not only safe and energy efficient but also advantageous in relation to vehicle intellectualization and operation. Firstly, this work illustrates the connection between modern vehicle growing operating data volumes and the necessity of the rational data exchange process organization with the help of complex solutions and various data transfer technologies. Secondly, certain technical solutions for data exchange functions as well as for digital control of a lightweight working vehicle electric propulsion system are presented in this article. Thirdly, the article comprises the results of the said functions practical implementation in the form of a high-performance modular platform consistent with the perspective requirements in terms of speed, capacity and reliability of the digital control. Finally, this paper outlines real life solutions of such system equipment and software: it describes an actual application interface which provides control and operation of vehicle electric propulsion system key components using a wireless connection through a mobile device.

articleTitle: Spatial Signal Processing in Centrally Symmetric Linear and Circular Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The aim of this work has been the synthesis and analysis of adaptive fast solution algorithms for spatial signal processing for implementation in centrally symmetric equidistant linear and circular antenna arrays using MATLAB environment. For the linear antenna array, the Voyevodin recurrence algorithm has been used as the adaptive fast solution algorithm, and for the circular antenna array, the Fast Fourier Transform algorithm has been used. This paper provides a mathematical description of the algorithms and investigates the sensitivity of the algorithms to changes in the angle of arrival of clutter.

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Communicating with Special Aircraft Passengers
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This work deals with the development of translating text into sign language for communication with passengers with impaired hearing perception onboard an aircraft or vessel. A review of existing research is presented, usually aimed at establishing correspondence between different speech formats in specific languages. The analysis of the existing systems of sign language translation is carried out, their advantages and disadvantages are determined. A mathematical model is presented that describes the process of translating text into sign language, invariant with respect to the language used. The technical requirements for the system of such a translation are formulated, the optimal implementation tools are described, and the corresponding semantic analysis is carried out based on the previously presented mathematical model.

articleTitle: Control of the Fuel-Air Mixture of Propane-Butane with Throttle Regulation by Flow Simulation in the FlowVision Software Package
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article analyzes the effect of holes and gas supply pressure on the excess air coefficient. A simulation of the gas mixing process was carried out in order to control the pressure using the car's ECU. Propane-butane was chosen as the studied fuel and an alternative to gasoline. Production of it will increase as a motor fuel. Modeling was carried out in the FlowVision software package in order to ensure the optimal composition of the mixture in various modes. The package makes it possible to calculate the mass fraction of propane-butane. The main reference positions of the throttle valve were selected: φ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">thr</inf> =100, 75, 50, 25%. The gas supply pressure values were obtained to ensure optimal α=1 in these positions, corresponding to the operating conditions of the exhaust gas converter. An algorithm for regulating gas pressure from the throttle position was also derived. The influence of the incoming air temperature on the mass fraction of propane-butane was studied, and an algorithm for controlling pressure depending on temperature was developed.

articleTitle: Estimation of Cross polarization due to rain over some stations in South Africa
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Recently, there have been a massive end-user demand for services that use broad bandwidths and high throughput; these requirements are often not achievable due to inadequate allocation of radio frequency resources. Migration to higher frequencies of microwave and millimeter wavelengths in satellite links is often selected as an immediate solution. Nevertheless, the transmission of electromagnetic waves in higher frequency bands continue to experience limitations due interruption of propagation impairments (such as raindrops and ice) in the atmosphere. The interference impaired by cross polar signals implicated in channel capacity of radio links results in depolarization. The impact of propagation impairments affects the transferred polarization energy to another orthogonal region (XPD). In this paper, an estimation of cross polarization over higher frequency bands (above 10 GHz) of Ka and Ku bands was conducted across South Africa; for considerable feature of satellite design for high system availability. The evaluation of cross polarization discrimination is computed applying enforced ITU-R Standard P.618-12 factors in South Africa for circular cross polarization in Earth-satellite propagation path over INTELSTAT IS-20 [PM]. The study has been conducted over eight stations in South Africa namely Durban, Cape Town, Pretoria, Bloemfontein, East London, Upington, Nelspruit and Polokwane. East London experienced the lowest cross polarization discrimination on the angle of elevation 23°. This implies high interference resulting in cross talk.

articleTitle: Radiophotonic Method for Doppler Frequency Shift Measurement of a Reflected Radar Signal Based on Tandem Amplitude-Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article describes a new method for the Doppler frequency shift (DFS) measurement of a radar microwave signal reflected from a moving object, based on radio photonics technologies. The DFS measurement device has the same structure as the sequential radiophotonic link with filtration and consists of a laser, a block of electro-optical modulators, a fiber Bragg grating (FBG), and a photodetector. The block of electro-optical modulators, in contrast to the known solutions based on a two-port Mach-Zehnder amplitude modulator, is based on two subunits, consisting of connected tandem single-port amplitude and phase modulators (TAPM). The general structure of the TAPM subunits is parallel-serial. The microwave signal reflected from the object arrives at the first TAPM, which forms the measurement channel. The second and third TAPMs, connected in series, form a reference channel connected in parallel to the measurement one. The second TAPM receives a reference signal from the locator transmitter at the probing microwave frequency, after which the two-frequency radiation, spaced by twice of the probing frequency, is fed to the third TAPM, which generates from each component of the two-frequency radiation two more with a difference frequency equal to twice the maximum possible DFS. The beats of signals from the measurement and reference channels at the output of the photodetector are three high-frequency (GHz) or low-frequency (MHz) electrical signals, the frequencies and powers of which used for the DFS determination.

Author Keywords: Doppler frequency shift of the reflected signal

articleTitle: Investigation of Some Psychological and Pedagogical Phenomena Related to Distance Education in Engineering University
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents an overview of contemporary studies related to various aspects of digitization of education in higher education. The authors substantiate some important and noticeable psychological and pedagogical phenomena related to online learning, based on practical experience of its implementation in an aerospace engineering university. The case study proposes result of qualitative and quantitative analysis caried on as survey among university students. The article draws conclusions on the merits and drawbacks of this practice and outlines a list of qualities the students expect the teacher to have in the circumstances related to the pandemic and distance learning.

articleTitle: Minimization of Transient Distortions in the Ionospheric Wave Reception System by a Phased Array Antenna with Controlled Polarization Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the minimization of transient distortions in a system for receiving an ionospheric wave by a phased antenna array with a controlled polarization characteristic. For this, frequency separation of the ordinary and unusual components of the ionospheric wave is performed by receiving on a phased antenna array with a controlled polarization characteristic, as well as methods for optimizing the receiving system using an antenna with a controlled polarization characteristic. To consider the complex trajectories of the electric vector of the wave and the ends of the rotating antenna element, the hodograph of the vector of the ordinary and extraordinary components of the wave was used as an instrument. Optimization can be achieved by minimizing the deviation of the antenna EMF hodograph from the reference one, formed as a result of training a neural network, the resolution of which is quite sufficient to obtain a satisfactory result.

articleTitle: Application of the Theory of Optimal Control for Synchronization of Multiposition Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Recently, the issues of theory and practice of multi-position systems for various purposes remain relevant. A feature of such systems is the use of spatiotemporal methods of processing information embedded in wave fields and radio signals received simultaneously in spatially spaced positions. Such multi-position systems have a fairly wide variety and applications- radar radio navigation, radio geodesy, radio astronomy, ets. In such systems the mutual binding of spaced positions is necessary not only in time, but also in high frequency phases. Such systems use information about the spatiotemporal characteristics of the electromagnetic field. including in the ratio of the initial phases of the signals at the inputs of spased positions. The solution of the problem of synthesizing the optimal synchronization structure of multi-position radio engineering system is obtained on the basis of the theory of nonlinear filtering and stochastic optimal control.

articleTitle: Development of Methods and Tools for Testing Modern Passenger Cars for Noise Immunity of On-Board Electrical Complex
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article contains main results of work on improving the method of testing the on-board electrical complex of passenger cars for noise immunity to electromagnetic influences in various frequency ranges by the most common methods. The need for electromagnetic compatibility tests is determined by the influence of electromagnetic radiation, depending on its characteristics. During testing by exposure to electromagnetic radiation, the initial calibration of the acting electromagnetic field is provided for by frequency and duration, which is closest to the operating conditions of vehicles. The issues of the influence of direct and reflected electromagnetic radiation, their registration during testing, and ways to improve the noise immunity of electrical equipment of cars by using various materials, including radio-absorbing coatings, are also considered.

articleTitle: Radiophotonic Amplitude-Phase Modulation Solutions for Angle of Arrival Estimation Using L-Shaped Antenna Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses new methods for the angle of arrival (AOA) estimation at certain frequencies using interferometric phase measurements on elements of a flat antenna array and instantaneous frequency measurement (IFM) based on photonic signal processing of the received radio signal. The possibility of using the proposed methods for the transition from two-dimensional (2D) antenna structures to three-dimensional (3D) L-shaped antenna structures is considered. The block of electro-optical modulators is based on a two parallel subunits, consisting of tandem single-port amplitude and phase modulators (TAPM). Experimental results show that the AOA estimation in the range from 0 to π/2 is possible with an error of less than ±1.7 mrad with an error of ± 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> when determining the power of the informative component at the frequency of the reflected signal.

articleTitle: Decision Support System for Repair of Street and Road Network Facilities
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper proposes using a decision support system (DSS) to plan repair and restoration work on the street and road network (SRN) of the metropolis. It is shown that the use of DSS opens up new possibilities for collecting, processing, and analyzing information allows for modeling complex objects and phenomena, predicting the remaining service life of the road surface, taking into account the properties of asphalt concrete mixture and its components concerning other factors: operating, climatic conditions, road geometry. The analysis results of analogs that currently exist on the market and the companies involved in developing similar systems are given. Describes the advantages of the Iskra DSS and describes its architecture. It is shown that, based on the results of processing and intellectual analysis of the data on the roadbed condition, Iskra SRN DSS generates proposals for repair and restoration work to ensure the normative values of longitudinal and transverse flatness, the traction ration, crack area, and road patch.

articleTitle: Radiophotonic Method for Angle of Arrival Estimation of a Reflected Radar Signal Based on Tandem Amplitude-Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes a new approach for the estimation of the direction or of the microwave signal reflected from the object, based on radio photonics technologies. The angle of arrival measurement device has the same structure as the classical fiber-optic communication channel and consists of a laser, a block of electro-optical modulators and a photodetector. The block of electro-optical modulators, in contrast to the known solutions based on a two-port Mach-Zehnder amplitude modulator, is based on two parallel subunits, consisting of tandem single-port amplitude and phase modulators (TAPM). A microwave signal reflected from the object with a time delay, the value of which is determined by the AOA, is sequentially received at the radio frequency inputs of two TAPMs through the receiving antennas connected to them. In this case, the initial components of the laser carrier at the output of the TAPM subunits of both channels are completely suppressed, which significantly distinguishes the proposed solution from the known ones for the better in terms of increasing the measurement accuracy. The beats of the output signals of the TAPMs at the output of the photodetector represent a signal reflected from the object, according to the power of which the AOA can be determined.

articleTitle: Formation and Optimization of the Constructive Basis of Airborne Radars
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The methods of formation and optimization of the constructive basis of airborne radar is considered in this article. The methods are based on the choice from alternative variants for covering the components parts by the ready-made modules of designing airborne radar, that best meets the requirements of the technical task. The practical implementation of this methods are based on the using of the MS SQL Server DBMS integrated with a multilayer perceptron. The perceptron makes it possible to optimize the selected ready-made modules according to a preference criterion, that includes design and economic parameters. The result of the optimization is the formation of a preferred variant of the constructive basis, which allows minimizing parameters such as: weight, size and cost of the device as a whole. The article also provides an example of the preferred variant of constructive basis of the airborne radar, formed on the basis of real ready-made modules from different manufacturers.

articleTitle: Smart City Transport Technologies: Infrastructure of the Future
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Communications make up the most important part of the city's infrastructure, and as "smart" technologies spread, transport becomes one of the areas of their most active application. With the development of the urbanization process, the load on the transport system is particularly increasing, new "challenges" arise for the management system of large municipalities related to ensuring the quality of life and safety expected by citizens. Modernization of the transport system in the context of population growth is the most effective within the framework of the "smart city" model. This means a course towards the integration of information and communication technologies for the management of urban infrastructure. The use of intelligent solutions in the development of the transport industry is aimed at reducing the importance of the "human" factor and related negative manifestations, reducing transaction costs for the economy, increasing manageability and optimizing traffic flow management, which gives a positive effect of creating a better infrastructure, environmentally friendly and socially favorable urban environment. The article discusses the concept of an intelligent transport system (ITS) as part of the concept of a "smart" city. The main advantages and risks of the introduction of intelligent transport systems, the prospects for their further development, as well as examples of digital forms of interaction between government and society on topical issues of urban governance are analyzed.

articleTitle: Object Distinction in Noisy Images
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The aim of the work is to develop and study an adaptive algorithm for selection and differentiation of isolated compact objects by their shape. For the analysis, monochrome images inherent in remote sensing systems were considered, the proposed multi-threshold approach is based on the formation of a set of binary slices that are used for morphological processing by selecting objects, analyzing their geometric characteristics and subsequent selection. One of the problems is to establish the connection of each pixel of the image with a specific object on a sequence of binary slices. To solve this problem, the rate of change in the area of the object with an increase in the threshold and fragmentation of the object due to the percolation effect are analyzed. Another problem is related to the selection and use of geometric characteristics of the object to adapt the threshold level. What is new is the use of object selection results for image segmentation, which allows you to set lower-level thresholds without increasing interference. An example of distinguishing objects in the form of a disk and a square appearing on a noise Gaussian background is considered. The potential distinguishing characteristics that coincide with the simulation results are calculated. The possibility of selection and differentiation of these objects using multi-threshold processing is investigated. Examples of distinguishing compact objects in real images obtained by on-board surveillance systems are presented.

articleTitle: Identification of Road Defects with a Smart Camera
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the process of identifying roadway defects used in automated mobile laboratories by searching for the edges of an object. The introduction of automated systems using machine vision will significantly reduce the laboriousness of the process of detecting defects in roads, will make it possible to control at a higher level and increase the speed of processing the results. During the development process on LabVIEW software, the main algorithms for the interaction of a smart camera with an on-board system were described. The process of image binarization, its frequency filtering through the Fourier transform is described. To get around this limitation, the article discusses fast Fourier transform algorithms.

articleTitle: Acoustic Fault Trace as a Diagnostic Parameter of Modern Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper deals with the tendencies in the development of automobile market, changes in the structure and forms of car ownership, changes in the characteristics of drivers. The tasks in the field of automobile transport operation and trends in the production of modern automobiles are studied. The trend toward connected cars and a high degree of automation, both in terms of vehicle management and diagnostics, is assessed. The collected statistics of sub-dealer service for the last 3 years (Volvo cars) allowed us to give a reasonable assessment of the many symptoms of malfunctions, which are recorded by the car owner during the formation of an order for repair. The physical concept of “sound” was considered. The made conclusions allow to assert the necessity of introduction of a new parameter for diagnostics of a modern car. The relevance of the introduction of acoustic trace of malfunction as a diagnostic parameter of modern car in the context of existing trends is considered. The justification of using this parameter not only for passenger cars, but also for commercial and passenger vehicles, especially for urban (urban passenger transport, UPT) is presented.

articleTitle: Modified Newton’s Method in Massive MIMO Demodulation with non-Gaussian Approximation
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The realities of modern mobile communications with tangible changes in the needs and expectations of subscribers lead to the need of demodulation algorithms with good noise immunity characteristics and acceptable computational complexity for practical use in systems with large number of antennas (Massive MIMO). The application of a non-Gaussian approximation of the a priori distribution of the estimated parameters for Massive MIMO systems demodulation using the modified Newton method is proposed. A study of a new algorithm was carried out under conditions of a different number of antennas and different types of modulation. The results of studying the noise immunity characteristics of the modified Newton’s method are presented, and a comparison is made with the well-known MMSE algorithm, which confirm the effectiveness of the proposed approach of non-Gaussian approximation and the modified Newton’s method for demodulation in Massive MIMO systems.

articleTitle: Application of New Technologies and Software in the Development of a New Laboratory Stand for Studying the Discipline of Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article considers the issues of organizing the educational process when studying the disciplines "Electrical Engineering", "Theory of Electrical Circuits", "Theoretical Foundations of Electrical Engineering" and "Fundamentals of Computer Analysis of Electrical Circuits" at the Department of Electrical Circuit Theory of Moscow Technical University of Communications and Informatics. When studying these disciplines, the educational process includes lecture, practical classes and laboratory work in specialized laboratories on stands equipped with measuring devices and radio technical elements. In addition, the department has personal computers with software that allows to process the results of field experiments, compile reports, and also simulate processes that occur in electrical circuits. The stands used at the department were developed by the teachers of the department Drago G.N. and Dobrotvorsky I.N. For many years, these stands have been successfully used in many universities and colleges. Inevitably, the time comes when the instruments built into the stand are morally outdated, and the task arises to develop a new stand for the laboratory workshop. In this work, the criteria that a modern laboratory stand should meet are considered.

articleTitle: Modeling the Movement of Trucks in a Traffic Flow of High Density
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: When modeling the movement of vehicles to develop intelligent transport systems and solve the problems of optimizing traffic flows in most cases, the mean values of average speeds and parameters of acceleration and deceleration are used. Experimental studies have shown that the standardized data used to calibrate models are far from reality. In the case of high-density traffic (traffic difficulties, road accidents, "traffic jams"), the movement characteristics of different vehicles are quite different. Studies have shown that weather and road conditions have a particular effect on changes in vehicle traffic characteristics. This is especially true for the movement of medium- and heavy-duty trucks. Relative values of average speeds, acceleration and deceleration values with a distribution by type of transport, obtained as a result of practical research, allow to obtain greater reliability in modeling real traffic flows in intelligent transport ecosystems.

articleTitle: Technique for Studying Mobile Communications Systems Signal Power Amplifier Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: For memoryless resonant power amplifier, a technique has been developed and a study of potential indicators of its efficiency in amplifying a signal described as band-pass noise with an amplitude envelope distributed according to Rayleigh's law has been carried out. The considered signal model is typical for group signals of mobile communication systems. The developed technique is based on a more detailed piecewise linear approximation of the static characteristics of the power amplifier than usual, consideration of the normalized input signal level at which its nonlinear distortions begin, and also the introduction of the concept of the nominal cutoff angle associated with this voltage. Based on the developed idealized model of a nonlinear power amplifier, an estimate of the potential average amplification efficiency of a typical complex composite signal characteristic of mobile communication systems was obtained. It is shown that the maximum possible value of the power amplifier efficiency in the ideal case cannot exceed (13-15)%.The presented approach can be used to estimate the potentially achievable average efficiency of signal amplification with any given function of the probability density of the values of its amplitude envelope.

Author Keywords: amplitude envelope of the group signal
distribution function of the amplitude envelope

articleTitle: Comparison of Dynamic Characteristics of BPSK Signal Demodulators Based on Costas and GLSS Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A comparison is made of the dynamic characteristics of BPSK signal demodulators based on the Costas and GLSS structures for the initial synchronization mode. The study was carried out by simulation methods on the example of designing a demodulator for a low-orbit satellite communication system with an information transfer rate of 1 Mbit/s. During the simulation, it was shown that the GLSS BPSK demodulator significantly exceeds the Costas BPSK demodulator in synchronization speed. The difference in the initial synchronization time at the maximum initial frequency detuning of 136 kHz at the beginning of the communication session was about 30 times. The calculation showed that the amount of equivalent frequency offset that a GLSS BPSK demodulator can eliminate in a fixed time interval of the initial synchronization is two orders of magnitude greater than a Costas BPSK demodulator.

articleTitle: The perceptron Training Process Optimization for Recognizing Graphic Objects in an Image
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The training process of a single-layer perceptron to recognize graphic objects on a pre-segmented image is considered and proposals for the most saving neural network structure are formulated. To describe the images, descriptors invariant to the full group of affine transformations were used, their values were the inputs of a neural network. At the perceptron outputs, the number of graphic objects of each type identified in the image was formed. The training procedure was based on the error back-propagation algorithm. Based on the results of the numerical experiment, the minimum number of the perceptron hidden layer neurons was determined, which guarantees the convergence of the training process, and the training sample volume influence on this amount was revealed. It is shown that for any volume of the training sample, there is a corresponding number of neurons in the perceptron hidden layer, which guarantees a minimum amount of computational work in the process of achieving zero training error.

articleTitle: Aging of Fiber Bragg Gratings to Reduce the Drift of the Sensor Response on Their Basis at High Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents the results of an experimental study of the phenomenon of the resonant wavelength drift of a fiber Bragg grating (FBG) recorded in a hydrogenated germanate quartz optical fiber under stationary action of an increased (+ 100 °C) temperature for a long time. The authors have shown that for FBG that did not undergo preliminary aging at a temperature higher than the operating temperature, the drift of the central wavelength after the first heating cycle lasting 2.5 hours at a temperature of + 100 °C was 80 pm, which corresponds to a change in the temperature sensor response of ~ 6 ° C. To reduce the detected drift, the authors selected the FBG aging modes (temperature and cycle duration), which ensure a decrease in drift to values, that do not exceed the error of a commercial interrogation device used in the course of experiments at a constant elevated temperature for 24 hours.

articleTitle: Test Implementation of an SDR-based Noise-immune Data Transmission Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes a test example of practical implementation of the prototype for binary data transmission line over a radio channel using software-defined radio as a technical platform. The main design stages are highlighted and the main functional scheme of the design system are presented. The particular functional layouts of the receiver and transmitter was developed using GNU Radio companion software as specialized digital signal processing platform. The operational analysis of the proposed system prototype was conducted. The direct spread sequence approach is considered as a way to gaining increase in noise immunity level. It was shown that the assumption about the reliability and noise immunity of the implemented radio link remains valid under some conditions. The proposals for further modification and possible improvements of the described system are briefly discussed.

articleTitle: Using Software Simulation for Comparative Analysis of Operating Parameters of V8 and L6 Diesel Engines Having the Same Displacement and Power
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The goal of this paper was to estimate a gain in fuel efficiency of a truck V8 turbocharged diesel engine if it is replaced by a L6 diesel engine having the same displacement and power. For this, a V8 engine with two turbochargers and L6 engine with one turbocharger were compared by simulation using the AVL BOOST software. Both engines had a similar torque by the full load characteristic. The factors influencing the fuel efficiency: indicator efficiency, pumping losses, turbocharger efficiency and others were analyzed. The L6 engine demonstrated a uniform pattern of pressure pulsations in the exhaust manifold and at the turbine inlet. The V8 engine had an uneven pattern and higher amplitude of pulsations which resulted in higher pumping losses and lower turbine efficiency. The brake specific fuel consumption of the L6 engine was by 3.5-7.0 percent lower than that of the V8 engine.

articleTitle: A method for Assessing the Interoperability of Application Software Based on Object-Oriented Polychromatic Sets of Composition and Properties of Their Data
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The new approach of an estimation of interoperability of the applied software on the basis of structure of their data, consisting in representation of the information about entity is offered to a subject domain in the form of object-oriented polychromatic set for calculation of interoperability as the factor of the compatibility equal to the relation of volume coordinated between systems entity to the common volume same entity. From the proposed method, due to the assessment of the use of joint data of various systems in their databases, the human factor is excluded from the analysis of the interoperability of application software.

articleTitle: A General Approach to Dependability Assessment of Intelligent Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Dependability is an essential factor for Intelligent Transport Systems, as transport is very important for providing a living environment and failures in such a system can lead to a dangerous situation for the road user. The paper suggests using the effectiveness retention ratio as a dependability measure for such systems. This allows taking into account partial failures. The definition of this measure is given, its meaning for Intelligent Transport Systems in few typical cases is specified, and evaluation methods are proposed.

articleTitle: Detection of Doppler Signatures of Complex Shapes Using the Wavelet Correlation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The tasks of remote control of modern devices are relevant both for household appliances and game installations, and for specialized equipment. The disadvantages of remote control panels are solved by gesture recognition systems, which often use a video camera as a sensor, which places rather strict requirements on lighting and significantly limits the range of recognizable movements. These shortcomings are devoid of contactless control systems based on the principles of bio-radar, the signal processing algorithms of which are discussed in the article. Since human movements have low repeatability, the amplitude and frequency properties of signals reflected from a person performing some movement or gesture are different from repetition to repetition, which prevents the control system from correctly recognizing the movement. It is proposed to use the wavelet transform to solve the problems of detecting and recognizing signals reflected from a person performing a given movement.

articleTitle: The Use of a Radio Navigation System for Landing a Rotary-Wing Aircraft on the Deck of a Ship in Adverse Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article deals with the problem of helicopter landing on a moving platform under adverse weather conditions. The article presents a study of the possibility of automatic determination of coordinates using antennas located on the blades of a helicopter propeller, relative to the landing pad, on which the radio signal sources are located. A variant of the implementation of such a system is proposed, its main characteristics are described. The possibility of using this system for helicopter landing in adverse weather conditions has been assessed. The implementation of such a system will make it possible to solve the problems of ensuring navigation during landing in difficult weather conditions, as well as during search and rescue operations.

Author Keywords: determining the coordinates of the radio signal source
the antenna on the helicopter rotor blades

articleTitle: Study of Optical Fibre Cables Long-Term Operation at Elevated Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper focuses on research of newly designed radiation resistant optical fibre cables for application in harsh environments, where elevated temperatures are one of those. To make a conclusion whether it is possible to use these cables under elevated temperatures a series of experiments were held where performance (attenuation coefficient and Mandelstam-Brillouin scattering) of the cables and optical fibre were measured before, during and after the tests – accelerated aging and non-accelerated aging. Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), thermomechanical analysis (TMA) and IR-spectroscopy of polymer coatings of optical fibre and optical fibre cables were held before and after the exposure of the samples to elevated temperatures. Test results of accelerated and non-accelerated aging showed that accelerated aging does not fully represent behavior of polymer material under study. The results showed that designed specialty optical fibre cables are suitable to be used under elevated temperatures (100 °C and above) for more than 10 000 hours.

articleTitle: Improved Space Time Codes through Orthogonal Transformation
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper provides description of the new algorithm of orthogonal precoding for multiple-input multipleoutput (MIMO) systems. The idea of using orthogonal transformation for improving gaining is being implemented for 2x2 Golden code. Previously the optimization methods for spacetime codes (STC) used simulation to get the optimal structure instead of this paper where we offer an analytical approach. Then we realized some concerns about covariance matrix for MMSE-based demodulator and offer some restraints for main diagonal elements. This approach might be useful for any type of STC. Simulation results for 8x8 and 16x16 MIMO channels verify that proposed algorithm provides improved performance at energy efficiencies about 2 – 5 dB. Complexity of receiver algorithm does not increase in this approach.

articleTitle: Highly-Selective Two-Resonator Microstrip Low-Pass Filters
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The authors analyze the potential selective capabilities of two-resonator microstrip low-pass filter structures. This work shows the conditions for spurious passband spectrum discharge up to and including the fourth harmonic in the two-resonator structure and forming at least seven working attenuation poles in it. These features provide, with such a limited number of resonators, a significantly increased frequency selectivity of the low-pass filters in a wide frequency band and a reduced loss level in the passband. Thus, using the example of LPF realization, it is shown that compact two-resonator structures have a sufficient number of freedom degrees to show up selective properties, which are characteristic of multi-resonator microwave circuits. The unique feature of this type of frequency response predetermines new possibilities in the design of highly selective, higher-order filters based on compact structures with a limited number of resonators.

Author Keywords: zeroes and poles of working attenuation

articleTitle: Design and actualization of the road database
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The features of data exchange and the main sources of information required to make an informed decision on the need for repair work on the SRN objects are considered. Analyzed the functions of visual inspection and described the objects of the main categories of monitoring for their entry in the road database and the functions of the sampling process. The composition of applications and functions of the road database is defined. A conceptual diagram of the road database is presented, which contains all the necessary information about the objects of the road network, as well as the results obtained during monitoring using mobile road laboratories. Schemes of several applications ("Visual Inspection", "Cores and Analysis", "Diagnostic Results") are provided with a description of the implemented or functions.

articleTitle: Modulation Parameters Analysis of Modern Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the technologies and standards of modern communication systems in terms of transceiver devices structure from analog-to-digital conversion to a stream of symbol decisions at the demodulator output. Structural classification of wired/wireless networks, communication standards, types of signal modulation has been carried out. The features of the transceivers hardware implementation, transmission rates and operating conditions of communication channels has been also taken into account. As a result of the analysis, a set of modulation types has been determined, which are currently used in most communication channels, as well as the main parameters of its operation.

articleTitle: Methods for Measuring the Electrophysical Parameters of Semiconductor Wafers of VLSI
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents a fundamentally new software package TM-Studio, designed to measure electrical parameters when testing VLSI. The complex receives all the data for testing from the electronic accompanying sheets of the product. As a result, most of the shortcomings of the traditional approach to automation of the measurement process are eliminated. The concept of a measuring function was introduced and implemented in software, which made it possible to reduce the entire process of measuring electrophysical parameters to several standardized procedures that are easily adaptable to changing measurement conditions. The proposed complex allows you to change the measurement parameters in real time, which improves the quality of the traceability of objects of labor and reduces the overall complexity of the stage of measuring electrophysical parameters. The article compares the testing time of the same batch of wafers by two systems: (1) the well-known graphical measurement automation environment Keysight Technologies and (2) the TM-Studio complex developed according to the proposed method. The results of the comparison showed that the use of the proposed complex allows several times to speed up the process of manufacturing semiconductor wafers.

articleTitle: Stripline Quadrature Coupler Design
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In our article, we tried to solve the issue of the bulkiness of directional couplers implemented on substrates with a low permittivity and operating frequency. The paper describes the results of research on the miniaturization of a flat directional coupler. We have briefly described the steps that a designer must follow to create a compact power divider. Due to the fact that the proposed device was manufactured and measured on a vector network analyzer, we were able to confirm the effectiveness of our approach. This is how the 1 GHz power divider was designed and manufactured. Due to the use of tape structures, it was possible to reduce its area by 75% compared to the traditional implementation. From the negative, there was a decrease in the band by 4.4% and a complication of the topology of the product.

articleTitle: Estimation of a Radiation Source Location by Difference-Energy Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper analyzes a difference-energy method for determining the location of radiation sources (RS) based on measuring the levels of signals received from the RS at N reception points (RP) of a multi-position system (MPS), which is a group of aircrafts. The RS coordinates are defined as the point of intersection of the position lines representing Apollonian circles or spherical surfaces. The focus points of the Apollonius circles are the points of the location of the aircrafts. In the proposed method, each aircraft in the group is equipped with radio receivers, a navigation system and a communication system with an information collection and processing point. Using the established mathematical apparatus, the analytical estimates of RS positioning and the position finding accuracy estimates were obtained. Based on the developed computer calculation model, quantitative characteristics of the RS location estimation accuracy were obtained. A comparison of the accuracy estimates for the difference-energy and direction-finding methods with the same relative position of the aircraft and RS were performed. The presented method can be used in systems of air control of the electronic situation for determination of the interesting RS coordinates.

articleTitle: On–Board X–Band Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: At present, there is a need for on-board antenna of radio date communication of target information. This is actually for all types of spacecrafts, including small spacecrafts. An overview of the using types of on-board antennas of radio date communication of target information is presented. Advantages and disadvantages are shown. In this paper a scheme for constructing an antenna array of polarizers with a linear partition is proposed, which provides the required energy and polarization characteristics of the antenna array of radio date communication of target information installed on-board the spacecraft. Numerical modeling of the element and the antenna array is carried out. The influence of the element design parameters on the directional characteristics and frequency characteristics is determined. The methods of synthesis of the radiation pattern of a multi-element antenna array and the issues of its practical implementation are considered.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Possibility of Organizing Communication in the Ultraviolet Wavelength Range
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The search for new methods of organizing secure communications in the absence of direct visibility of correspondents led to research in the range of ultraviolet wavelengths. The UVC range is characterized by a low noise level from the Sun, a high degree of radiation scattering due to the commensurability of the radiation wavelength and the size of molecules and aerosols in the air.
