Communication in the ultraviolet waveband has unique features, such as a small radius of action, which means it is difficult to detect, the ability to deliver information outside the direct line of sight of correspondents, which means it can be used in urban and forest areas, a non-distributed frequency range (wavelengths), the equipment is a unique device. Research on this topic has been going on since the 1960s, and with the advent of new semiconductor devices, the ultraviolet waveband has flared up with renewed vigor. The article describes the model of the communication channel of the ultraviolet waveband, draws attention to the choice of components of the communication device layout, and also describes the experiments carried out.

articleTitle: Spectral Processing and Detection of Optical Signals in Systems for Multicriteria Control of Physical and Physicochemical Processes
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Based on the methods of optical spectroscopy a new principle of generating error signals in systems for multicriteria control is proposed. These systems are intended for control of processes that are accompanied by emission of electromagnetic radiation in the optical range. Instead of traditional measuring devices using a multichannel optical spectrometer and a diffraction spectral device with a fiber-optic transmission system (FOTS) of analyzed signals to generate error signals is proposed. An analysis of the formation of error signals based on spectral processing and detection of optical signals by the considered spectral devices is given. Spectral processing in these devices can be described in matrix form, and devices itself can be determined as multidimensional linear systems.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology to Determine the Need for Repair Work of Road Elements
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Ensuring road safety and reducing mortality in road accidents is a priority for the development of the Russian Federation, which reflected both in presidential decrees and in the transport strategy of the Russian Federation until 2030 with a forecast for the period up to 2035. The use of artificial intelligence technologies in assessing the operational state of road safety systems and road equipment elements will allow timely operational control by visual and instrumental assessment methods and make decisions on repair or replacement. Prompt repair and restoration works will ensure compliance of working and design parameters of road arrangement elements during operation. Recording of the data obtained from the results of operational monitoring into the developed IS “ModAS” to support the decision to select a new design of the road safety system will make it possible to evaluate the normative state at all stages and stages of the life cycle of each safety system design and predict operational costs. In particular, assess the need to carry out urgent repairs of road safety systems or a road element based on the results when defects detected in the monitoring process based on digital virtual validated analysis.

articleTitle: Methods of Indicators Analysing for Universities Publication Activity by discipline "Radio engineering"
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article systematizes the means of bibliometric analysis of authors, scientific organizations, journals and areas of research in accordance with their structure or functions. The systematization was carried out in terms of the expediency of their use for managing information flows and evaluating the effectiveness of organization's scientific activities. Useful information about main technical aspects of citation analysis and scientometrics in general is presented. The methods considered in the article are used in the preparation students of technical universities by discipline "Fundamentals of Scientific Research" in the direction of master's training "Radio Engineering" (master's programs "Audiovisual Technologies", "Systems and Devices for Transmission, Reception and Processing of Signals") and in the direction of "Infocommunication technologies and communication systems" (master's programs: "Multiservice infocommunication technologies", "Radio communication systems, mobile communication and radio access").

articleTitle: Using the Principles of Mobile Systems Modeling for LoRaWAN Characteristics Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The LoRaWAN technology specification ensures perfect interoperability between IoT devices without the need for complex local implementations. In addition, it enables the deployment of energy efficient long-range networks with low power consumption. Also, the relatively low cost of solutions based on LoRaWAN standard is also very often a determining factor when choosing a technology for organizing a machine-to-machine communication (M2M) network. However, the mathematical modelling of such systems is quite new direction and there are no concrete results in this field yet. In this paper, the mathematical model of LoRaWAN cell is studied. It appeared as a result of the analysis of the information transmission process in cellular mobile networks, optimized for data transmission. Among them, for example, there are CDMA2000 1xEV-DO standard and its 3GPP analogue of HSDPA. This model allows us to take into account such important LoRaWAN feature like ADR mechanism. The article provides formulas for estimating the main characteristics of the model. The performed numerical experiments confirm the possibility of using the considered methods for the analysis and planning of LoRaWAN networks

articleTitle: The Analysis of International Standards in the Field of Safety Regulation of Highly Automated and Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article examines the safety structure of highly automated vehicles (HAV), substantiates the problems of assessing and ensuring the safety of automated driving systems. It presents the main initiative groups at the international level engaged in the development of a safety regulation system for highly automated and autonomous vehicles. The main international standards that currently exist and those, that develop and can potentially serve as a basis for a safety regulation system development for highly automated and autonomous vehicles, are considered and analyzed in the article. The aspects of an integrated approach for the development of a safety regulation system of HAVs are formulated.

articleTitle: Some Features of the Implementation of Educational Processes in the Context of the Industrial Revolution 4.0
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The processes realized by Industrial Revolution 4.0 and general digitalization predetermine a very intensive Information and communication technologies, communication means and hardware and software for their implementation. These processes are transforming the entire set of socio-economic relations and the structure and content of the labour market. In its turn, the labor market forms demands regarding the formation of human resources, first of all, in the sphere of education. Educational processes, in particular in higher education institutions, are carried out over a rather long period of time (5-7 years). There is a long time interval between the formation of demand on the labour market for highly-qualified personnel in a certain sphere of activity and the actual formation of the necessary competencies in university graduates. Therefore, a number of trends have emerged in the field of education due to a radical change in the labour market situation, in particular, the lack of specialists engaged in practical professional activities with the use of innovative information and communication technologies. This research focuses on analyzing the above-mentioned trends and forecasting scenarios for the development of the real situation in the labor market and in the educational sphere.

Author Keywords: Information and communication technologies and information security

articleTitle: Priority Ways to Ensure Cybersecurity of Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers topical issues of ensuring cybersecurity of cooperative intelligent transport systems and problems associated with accelerated digital transformation. The results of the analysis of the direction of cyberattacks, their distribution by economic sectors are presented. The structural features of control systems of cooperative intelligent transport systems, their digital inequality and its consequences are considered. The results of the analysis of complex solutions to ensure cybersecurity, including through the use of digital twins of protected systems as cyber polygons for solving problems of detecting cyberattacks and responding to them are presented. The priority ways of solving the C-ITS cybersecurity issues are proposed

Author Keywords: integrated automated system corporate management and technological control

articleTitle: Modeling the Performance of Onboard Data Server with Random Input Information Stream
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The efficiency of operation of any onboard equipment and the reliability of information exchange with ground flight service stations depend on the performance of the onboard information and computing system. The article presents the results of the performance modeling of an onboard data server (ODS) using the methods of queuing theory. The model builds under the assumption that the parameters characterizing the input stream are random variables with arbitrary probability distribution functions. The numerical experiments have shown the high sensitivity of the ODS performance indicators to the choice of the probability distribution function for the parameters of the input stream. The execution time of service requests can increase by an order of magnitude when the probability distribution function of the input stream parameters changes, which takes into account deploying additional functional applications. Another important feature of the experiments performed is the calculation of the maximum threshold values of service quality indicators, which guarantees not to be exceeded for a given fraction of the total flow of service requests.

articleTitle: Service Level Agreement with Differentiated Reliability Requirements : Efficiency of Application in Communication Networks and On-Board Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The reliability of the operation of fiber-optic networks and communication systems, i.e. the ability of a communication network to perform specified functions for transmitting information under specified conditions and for a specified time is the main requirement of customers for a telecommunications operator. The customer’s needs and expectations regarding the quality and reliability of the network and communication systems determine the requirements. They may differ not only qualitatively and quantitatively, but also depend on time. Customers of telecommunications companies may need certain periods of time during which additional stability of communication is required. The rest of the time, the standard level of communication stability is sufficient for them. The overall framework of the SLA usually provides increased reliability for the entire duration of the contract concluded between the customer and the operator, which is sometimes redundant and expensive for both the customer and the operator. The SLA framework is considered, which allows customers to independently determine the critical time slots in which the operator undertakes to fulfill their requirements for communication stability. This structure is called the SLA with differentiated requirements (SLAd). Critical Time Slots (CTS) correspond to periods when it is especially important for the customer to have reliable and uninterrupted communication. Therefore, connections during these periods are reserved using cross-duplication of customer data streams. The article evaluates the effectiveness of the implementation of a service level agreement (SLA) with time-differentiated reliability requirements. Net present value (NPV) is considered as a measure of efficiency; to take into account the probabilistic characteristics, the availability factor is applied. The results of calculations are presented and their brief analysis is given.

articleTitle: Modeling of Processes in the Field of IT Education Implemented with the Use of Remote Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: High rates of scientific and technological progress determine the constant increase in demand in the labor market for highly qualified specialists, primarily those engaged in professional activities using IT. In modern conditions, the most relevant skill for graduates of higher educational institutions is the ability to adapt to dynamic changes and improve the information and communication technologies themselves and the means of their implementation. Accordingly, this leads to a significant modernization of the sphere of higher education and the totality of educational processes. In particular, approaches to quality assessment and ways to adequately determine its level are changing. The authors in this article propose to effectively assess the quality of modern education, using mathematical models developed by them. These models are synthesized by the authors based on the theory of fuzzy sets. Which, in turn, allows us to generalize a number of qualitative and quantitative criteria. And, consequently, to ensure the adaptation of models for the implementation of educational processes depending on a variety of identifiable factors. The results of the research carried out by the authors of this article can be very useful for a wide range of representatives of various communities of participants in socio-economic relations.

articleTitle: Methodology Aspects for Radio Receivers Development of Technical Monitoring Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Within the framework of this article, a methodical approach to the development of radio monitoring receivers with high technical characteristics for assessing the parameters and current state of radio signal sources is outlined. One of the tasks of radio monitoring is to provide guaranteed detection of signals with modern types of modulation and various types of multiple access in a wide range of received signal powers. This task is divided into the following tasks: radio detection, estimation of signal parameters, as well as restoration and analysis of transmitted information. When solving the latter type of problems, the problem of determining the location of the source of information can also be solved. The listed tasks are proposed to be solved on the basis of the analysis of the parameters of the received signals. The latter largely depend on the quality of the radio receivers of the control system, especially when solving the problem of radio engineering analysis, when the parameters of the received signal are determined. At the same time, the work of modern technical means of monitoring is carried out in modes as close as possible to real time. This is due to the fact that modern radio electronic devices use various methods of noise protection, masking and encryption, which include fast and unpredictable tuning of the operating frequency, the use of a synthesized radiation pattern with the output of the minimum radiation in the direction of the intended control means, adaptive adjustment of the radiation power, the use of pseudo-noise signals with a large base, etc. The paper considers methodology aspects for radio receivers development of technical monitoring equipment, stages of designing such systems, and also presents examples of the implementation of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Digital Control System for Leveling of Construction Sites
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Automation of construction processes have always been relevant, and recently with the advent of satellite equipment, laser and gyroscopic equipment, digital control systems for hydro and electric drive of construction machines have been widely developed. It is especially important to use automated control systems (ACS) when performing labor-intensive construction processes, such as planning earthworks, roadworks, ballasting of the railway track, placing engineering structures in the design position, quality control of work and much more. The assessment of the processes of preparing the construction site for future construction shows that working with soils during earthworks using standard methods and mechanisms of loosening and planning is rather inefficient, while a more rational method is the method in which the intensification of the loosening process, developed surface profiles and side slopes is due to the complete automation of the technological process. Touching on the study of the excavation site for the work of special equipment, it is also worth paying attention to the importance of adjusting the position of not only the dump, but also the grader itself using satellite systems, namely GLONASS. This system is called a leveling system, which is one of the main trends of recent times in the field of road cars, in turn, such systems are very demanding for the processability of the machines on which they are installed. Accurate adjustment of the dump position, as well as the leveling system together, improve the process of removing the earth layer.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Distortions Compensation of Amplitude Phase Shift Keying Signals with Different Orders in Communication Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper is dedicated to solving the task of linearization an amplified tract in order to reduce the nonlinear distortions level of amplitude phase shift keying signals with different orders. Wiener model was used as power amplifier (PA). Digital predistortion method based on a memory polynomial model was used as a linearization method. The studies were carried out in MATLAB/Simulink visual programming environment. Evaluation of the efficiency of the realized compensation algorithm was based on the following parameters: Adjacent Channel Power Ratio (ACPR), Error Vector Magnitude (EVM), Amplitude Modulation/Amplitude Modulation (AM/AM) and Amplitude Modulation/Phase Modulation (AM/PM) characteristics, Bit Error Rate (BER) dependence on bit signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Thanks to the inclusion of Digital Predistorter (DPD) in the channel, we were able to achieve significant improvements in all parameters for each modulation case.

articleTitle: Engineering methodology for determining the electric power consumption for traction by an electric vehicle in different operating conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The engineering methodology and results of calculations of electric power consumption for traction by electric vehicles of specific brands in driving cycles and in real operating conditions, which are accepted in the Russian Federation as basic and operational norms, are presented. In this methodology, the values of the basic norms of electric power consumption for traction of electric vehicles in driving cycles are determined in three ways, differing in a different set of initial data without loss of reliability of calculated estimates according to experimental data from manufacturers. The weighted average error of the estimated estimate of the electric power consumption for traction of 46 considered brands of electric vehicles of class M1 was 5.9%.

articleTitle: Substantiation of the Periodicity of Multi-Scanning Radar Monitoring of Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper we analyze the issues of detecting trajectories of radar objects. We consider implementation of "track-before-detect" (TBD) methods of sequential and block type, implementing procedures for detecting trajectories and preliminary evaluation of their parameters. We analyze the influence of radar survey frequency on the effectiveness of the implementation of multi-scanning observation methods (TBD methods). As indicators of comparative analysis, we consider: the time of detection of trajectories, the quality of the obtained trajectory information, the features of the implementation of TBD methods at high and low frequency of survey (observations). We analyze the variants of multi-scanning observations of different periodicity to solve the detection-measurement problem based on the available a priori information. We substantiate the rational choice of radar observations frequency for the implementation of sequential and block-type TBD methods.

articleTitle: Analysing the Classical Signal Detection In Channels With Complex Interference-Noise Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents a specialized program for modeling well-known, including chaotic radio pulse processes, additive white and non-Gaussian noise, communications with multipath propagation of a signal, as well as classical signal processing algorithms in mobile communication systems, within the framework of the problem of detecting a signal in one-dimensional form, based on the MatLab language and taking into account the disadvantages inherent in both visual modeling tools and programming language. The modeling tools themselves, available in the future, will allow implementing a multidimensional signal processing option.

articleTitle: Application of Lagrange Variational Principle to Accurate Solution of Statistical Kalman Filtration Problem in Generalized Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: New method is proposed for restoring the trajectories of random processes under observational conditions corresponding to Kalman filtering, but with arbitrary distributions of the initial state. The approach is based on theoretical mechanics in the variational interpretation of Lagrange. It is noted that the proposed approach makes it possible to reduce the variance of errors up to two times at intermediate points of the observation interval and provides accurate solutions for a wide set of classes of apriori distributions of the initial state. Examples of solutions for cases of multimode and multidimensional distributions of the initial state, which do not allow separation of variables, are given. The proposed approach allows for a wide list of initial distributions to form optimal (according to the criterion of maximum posteriori probability) estimates of the starting positions of the trajectories of stochastic processes, in conditions when the dynamics and measurements correspond to the Kalman model.
